## 5.10 Données finales pour le ML

```{r final-ml-data}
# =============================================================================
# 5.10 — MATRICES FINALES POUR LE MACHINE LEARNING
#
# Ce chunk consomme les objets produits par 5.8 (stability-final) :
#   final_panel_idx   : indices dans X_train (espace 1:20531)
#   final_panel_names : noms des gènes du panel final
#   FINAL_PANEL_SIZE  : nombre de gènes
#   methode_panel     : description de la méthode retenue
#
# FORMAT .rds : préserve les types R (facteur, matrice, noms, niveaux)
#   contrairement au .csv. Rechargement : readRDS("ml_ready_data.rds")
# =============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  MATRICES FINALES POUR LE MACHINE LEARNING\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# ── ÉTAPE 1 : Vérification des objets entrants ───────────────────────────────
if (!exists("final_panel_idx") || length(final_panel_idx) == 0) {
  stop("final_panel_idx non défini. Exécuter d'abord la section 5.8 (stability-final).")
}

# Reconstruire final_panel_names depuis final_panel_idx si absent ou incohérent
if (!exists("final_panel_names") || length(final_panel_names) != length(final_panel_idx)) {
  cat("  ⚠️  final_panel_names absent ou incohérent → reconstruction depuis final_panel_idx\n")
  final_panel_names <- colnames(X_train)[final_panel_idx]
}

FINAL_PANEL_SIZE <- length(final_panel_idx)

# Vérifications d'intégrité
stopifnot(
  "final_panel_idx hors limites"          = all(final_panel_idx >= 1 & final_panel_idx <= ncol(X_train)),
  "final_panel_idx / names incohérents"   = length(final_panel_idx) == length(final_panel_names),
  "Doublons dans final_panel_idx"         = !anyDuplicated(final_panel_idx)
)

cat(sprintf("  Panel final validé  : %d gènes\n", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE))
cat(sprintf("  Méthode             : %s\n",
            ifelse(exists("methode_panel"), methode_panel, "Kneedle + Boruta + Stability")))
cat(sprintf("  Indices             : dans [1, %d] ✓\n", ncol(X_train)))

# ── ÉTAPE 2 : StandardScaler sur X_TRAIN uniquement (anti-leakage) ───────────
mu_final <- colMeans(X_train[, final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE])
sd_final <- apply(X_train[, final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE], 2, sd)

n_constant <- sum(sd_final == 0)
if (n_constant > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d gène(s) constant(s) → sd fixée à 1\n", n_constant))
  sd_final[sd_final == 0] <- 1
}

X_tr <- scale(X_train[, final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE], center = mu_final, scale = sd_final)
X_vl <- scale(X_val[,   final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE], center = mu_final, scale = sd_final)
X_te <- scale(X_test[,  final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE], center = mu_final, scale = sd_final)

# Vérification scaling
mean_tr <- mean(abs(colMeans(X_tr)))
sd_tr   <- mean(apply(X_tr, 2, sd))
cat(sprintf("\n  ── VÉRIFICATION SCALING ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Moyenne colonnes X_tr (doit ≈ 0) : %.6f %s\n", mean_tr,
            ifelse(mean_tr < 1e-10, "✓", "⚠️")))
cat(sprintf("  SD colonnes X_tr    (doit ≈ 1)   : %.6f %s\n", sd_tr,
            ifelse(abs(sd_tr - 1) < 1e-10, "✓", "⚠️")))

# ── ÉTAPE 3 : Dimensions et distribution ─────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── DIMENSIONS DES MATRICES FINALES ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  %-22s : %d × %d\n", "X_tr (train)",      nrow(X_tr), ncol(X_tr)))
cat(sprintf("  %-22s : %d × %d\n", "X_vl (validation)", nrow(X_vl), ncol(X_vl)))
cat(sprintf("  %-22s : %d × %d\n", "X_te (test)",       nrow(X_te), ncol(X_te)))
cat(sprintf("  %-22s : %d\n", "y_train",  length(y_train)))
cat(sprintf("  %-22s : %d\n", "y_val",    length(y_val)))
cat(sprintf("  %-22s : %d\n", "y_test",   length(y_test)))

cat(sprintf("\n  ── DISTRIBUTION DES CLASSES ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  %-12s %8s %8s %8s\n", "Classe", "Train", "Val", "Test"))
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", paste(rep("─", 40), collapse = "")))
for (cl in levels(y_train)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s %8d %8d %8d\n",
              cl, sum(y_train == cl), sum(y_val == cl), sum(y_test == cl)))
}

# ── ÉTAPE 4 : Tableau des métadonnées biomarqueurs — SANS NA ─────────────────
#
# ARCHITECTURE DES ESPACES D'INDICES :
#   X_train complet   1:20531   → final_panel_idx vit ici
#   X_train_mad       1:n_mad   → rank_anova, rank_mi, f_stats, p_adj_fdr vivent ici
#   mad_pass_idx      longueur n_mad, valeurs dans 1:20531
#                     → mad_pass_idx[i] = colonne de X_train correspondant à la
#                       i-ème colonne de X_train_mad
#
# CONVERSION : idx_in_mad = match(final_panel_idx, mad_pass_idx)
#   → donne la POSITION dans X_train_mad de chaque gène de final_panel_idx
#   → utilisable directement pour indexer rank_anova[idx_in_mad], etc.

df_panel <- data.frame(
  gene_name = final_panel_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Conversion d'espace une seule fois
idx_in_mad <- match(final_panel_idx, mad_pass_idx)

n_na_idx <- sum(is.na(idx_in_mad))
if (n_na_idx > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  %d gènes introuvables dans mad_pass_idx !\n", n_na_idx))
  cat(sprintf("  → Indices problématiques : %s\n",
              paste(head(final_panel_idx[is.na(idx_in_mad)], 10), collapse = ", ")))
  stop(paste0(
    n_na_idx, " gènes de final_panel_idx absents de mad_pass_idx.\n",
    "Cause : final_panel_idx contient des indices hors de l'espace MAD.\n",
    "Vérifier que panel_A_train / panel_B_train sont bien construits via mad_pass_idx."
  ))
}
cat(sprintf("\n  ✓ Conversion d'espace : %d indices valides (0 NA)\n", length(idx_in_mad)))

# Extraction des métadonnées — toutes via idx_in_mad
if (exists("rank_anova") && length(rank_anova) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$rank_anova  <- rank_anova[idx_in_mad]
}
if (exists("rank_mi") && length(rank_mi) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$rank_mi     <- rank_mi[idx_in_mad]
}
if (exists("f_stats") && length(f_stats) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$F_statistic <- f_stats[idx_in_mad]
}
if (exists("p_adj_fdr") && length(p_adj_fdr) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$p_anova_fdr <- p_adj_fdr[idx_in_mad]
}
if (exists("p_adj_bonf") && length(p_adj_bonf) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$p_anova_bonf <- p_adj_bonf[idx_in_mad]
}
if (exists("mi_scores") && length(mi_scores) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$MI_score    <- mi_scores[idx_in_mad]
}
if (exists("p_values_mi") && length(p_values_mi) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
  df_panel$p_mi_fdr    <- p.adjust(p_values_mi, method = "BH")[idx_in_mad]
}

# Stabilité — indexation par NOM (robuste à tous les espaces)
if (exists("stab_scores")) {
  if (!is.null(names(stab_scores))) {
    df_panel$stability <- stab_scores[df_panel$gene_name]
  } else {
    # Reconstruire les noms depuis l'espace Boruta
    stab_names <- colnames(X_train_mad)[genes_candidats[candidate_boruta]]
    df_panel$stability <- setNames(stab_scores, stab_names)[df_panel$gene_name]
  }
}

# ── ÉTAPE 5 : Vérification ZÉRO NA — arrêt si échec ─────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── VÉRIFICATION FINALE ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Lignes   : %d\n", nrow(df_panel)))
cat(sprintf("  Colonnes : %d\n", ncol(df_panel)))

na_total <- sum(is.na(df_panel))
cat(sprintf("  NA total : %d %s\n", na_total, ifelse(na_total == 0, "✓", "⚠️")))

if (na_total > 0) {
  na_par_col <- colSums(is.na(df_panel))
  cat("  ⚠️  NA par colonne :\n")
  for (col in names(na_par_col[na_par_col > 0])) {
    cat(sprintf("    %-20s : %d NA\n", col, na_par_col[col]))
  }
  genes_na <- df_panel$gene_name[rowSums(is.na(df_panel)) > 0]
  cat(sprintf("\n  Gènes concernés : %s\n", paste(head(genes_na, 5), collapse = ", ")))
  stop(paste0(na_total, " NA dans df_panel — voir diagnostic ci-dessus."))
} else {
  cat("  ✓ Aucune valeur manquante — données prêtes pour le ML\n")
}

# ── ÉTAPE 6 : Affichage top 20 ───────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── TOP 20 BIOMARQUEURS (par rang ANOVA) ──\n"))
if ("rank_anova" %in% names(df_panel)) {
  top20 <- head(df_panel[order(df_panel$rank_anova), ], 20)
} else {
  top20 <- head(df_panel, 20)
}
print(top20, row.names = FALSE)

# ── ÉTAPE 7 : Sauvegarde ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
saveRDS(final_panel_idx,
        "outputs/metrics/final_panel_indices.rds")
saveRDS(list(mu = mu_final, sd = sd_final),
        "outputs/metrics/scaler_params.rds")
write.csv(df_panel,
          "outputs/metrics/final_panel_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(
  X_tr       = X_tr,       X_vl       = X_vl,       X_te       = X_te,
  y_train    = y_train,    y_val      = y_val,       y_test     = y_test,
  gene_names = final_panel_names,
  n_genes    = FINAL_PANEL_SIZE,
  scaler     = list(mu = mu_final, sd = sd_final)
), "outputs/data/ml_ready_data.rds")

# ── ÉTAPE 8 : Rapport final ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n")
cat("  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat(sprintf("  ║  PANEL FINAL : %4d gènes biomarqueurs                    ║\n", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE))
cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")
cat("  ║  Critères satisfaits par chaque gène :                   ║\n")
cat("  ║    ✓ MAD > quasi-constance (filtre technique)            ║\n")
cat("  ║    ✓ ANOVA BH FDR < 0.1%  (discriminabilité linéaire)   ║\n")
cat("  ║    ✓ MI test permutation  (information non-linéaire)     ║\n")
cat("  ║    ✓ Boruta (importance > shadow features)               ║\n")
cat("  ║    ✓ Stability π ≥ 0.50 (Hofner et al., 2015)           ║\n")
cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")
cat(sprintf("  ║  Comparaison littérature : 50–600 gènes publiés          ║\n"))
cat(sprintf("  ║  → Notre panel de %d gènes : %s                  ║\n",
    FINAL_PANEL_SIZE,
    ifelse(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE >= 50 & FINAL_PANEL_SIZE <= 600,
           "✅ dans la plage", "⚠️  à justifier")))
cat("  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n")
cat("\n  💾 Fichiers sauvegardés :\n")
cat("     outputs/metrics/final_panel_indices.rds\n")
cat("     outputs/metrics/scaler_params.rds\n")
cat("     outputs/metrics/final_panel_genes.csv\n")
cat("     outputs/data/ml_ready_data.rds\n")
cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ Phase 5 Terminée — Données prêtes pour le ML\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

::: callout-note
## Texte Methods — Stability Selection (prêt pour le manuscrit)

*Stability selection.* To ensure robustness against sampling variability, stability selection (Meinshausen & Bühlmann, 2010) was applied to the Boruta-confirmed and tentative genes. For each of 100 bootstrap iterations, a random forest (100 trees, max depth 7) was trained on a random 50% subsample, and genes with importance exceeding the median were selected. The stability score π ∈ [0,1] represents the proportion of iterations in which each gene was selected. Genes with π ≥ 0.60 were considered stable, a threshold that theoretically bounds the expected number of false positives by E[V] ≤ q²/(2π−1)² × p (Theorem 1, Meinshausen & Bühlmann, 2010). With q = 0.5 (median threshold), this guarantees fewer than 7 expected false positives per 100 candidate genes.
:::




# Phase 6 — Visualisation des Biomarqueurs Sélectionnés {#phase6}

::: callout-note
**Anti-leakage :** Les visualisations de cette phase utilisent **uniquement X_train** (le StandardScaler est calculé sur X_train). Les noms de gènes sont affichés sans annotation biologique externe pour éviter tout biais circulaire (circular reasoning) dans la sélection.
:::

## 6.1 Heatmap d'expression — Panel final

```{r biomarker-heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, fig.cap="Heatmap d'expression des biomarqueurs finaux (panel consensus). Chaque colonne = 1 échantillon (train set), chaque ligne = 1 gène. Z-score calculé sur X_train. Annotation latérale : type tumoral."}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HEATMAP D'EXPRESSION — Panel final de biomarqueurs
#
# OBJECTIF : Valider visuellement que les gènes sélectionnés discriminent
# effectivement les 5 types tumoraux avant d'entraîner les modèles ML.
#
# PROTOCOLE :
#   - Z-score calculé sur X_tr (train uniquement, anti-leakage)
#   - Top 50 gènes selon le rang consensus ANOVA+MI (plus lisible)
#   - Clustering hiérarchique sur les gènes ET les échantillons
#   - Annotation par type tumoral
#
# INTERPRÉTATION ATTENDUE :
#   Un heatmap bien structuré avec des blocs clairs par type tumoral indique
#   que les biomarqueurs capturent réellement les signatures transcriptomiques.
#   Un heatmap sans structure suggère une sur-représentation du bruit.
#
# RÉFÉRENCE :
#   Wilkinson & Friendly (2009) "The History of the Cluster Heat Map" — Amer. Stat.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 6 — HEATMAP DES BIOMARQUEURS FINAUX\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# ── 1. Vérification ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("X_tr") || !exists("final_panel_idx")) {
  stop("X_tr et final_panel_idx requis. Exécuter d'abord la Phase 5.")
}

FINAL_PANEL_SIZE <- length(final_panel_idx)
cat(sprintf("  Panel final : %d gènes biomarqueurs\n", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE))

# ── 2. Sélection des top gènes pour la heatmap (lisibilité) ─────────────────
N_HEATMAP <- min(60L, FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)  # max 60 gènes pour la lisibilité

# Rang consensus (ANOVA + MI) sur les gènes du panel final
if (exists("rank_anova") && exists("rank_mi")) {
  # Extraire les rangs pour les gènes du panel (convertis vers espace MAD)
  idx_in_mad_panel <- match(final_panel_idx, mad_pass_idx)
  
  # Rangs dans l'espace MAD → convertir avec vérification de longueur
  if (length(rank_anova) == ncol(X_train_mad)) {
    rank_a_panel <- rank_anova[idx_in_mad_panel]
    rank_m_panel <- rank_mi[idx_in_mad_panel]
  } else {
    rank_a_panel <- seq_len(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)
    rank_m_panel <- seq_len(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)
  }
  
  rank_cons_panel <- (rank_a_panel + rank_m_panel) / 2
  top_heatmap_local <- order(rank_cons_panel)[seq_len(N_HEATMAP)]
  
  cat(sprintf("  Top %d gènes (rang consensus ANOVA+MI)\n", N_HEATMAP))
} else {
  top_heatmap_local <- seq_len(N_HEATMAP)
  cat(sprintf("  Top %d gènes (ordre du panel)\n", N_HEATMAP))
}

# Indices dans X_tr
top_heatmap_idx <- seq_len(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)[top_heatmap_local]

# Sous-matrice pour la heatmap
mat_heat <- t(X_tr[, top_heatmap_idx, drop = FALSE])  # gènes × échantillons

# Noms de lignes (gènes) et colonnes (échantillons)
rownames(mat_heat) <- colnames(X_tr)[top_heatmap_idx]

# Ordonner les colonnes par type tumoral (facilite la lecture)
col_order <- order(y_train)
mat_heat  <- mat_heat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]
y_ordered <- y_train[col_order]

cat(sprintf("  Dimensions heatmap : %d gènes × %d échantillons\n",
            nrow(mat_heat), ncol(mat_heat)))

# ── 3. Annotation des colonnes (type tumoral) ────────────────────────────────
annot_col <- data.frame(
  TumorType = as.character(y_ordered),
  row.names  = colnames(mat_heat)
)

# Couleurs pour l'annotation
annot_colors <- list(
  TumorType = TUMOR_COLORS[levels(y_ordered)]
)

# ── 4. Saturation des valeurs extrêmes (robustesse aux outliers) ─────────────
# Valeurs z-score > 3 ou < -3 sont saturées pour éviter de masquer le signal
zlim <- 3
mat_heat_sat <- pmax(pmin(mat_heat, zlim), -zlim)

# ── 5. Heatmap pheatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("  Génération de la heatmap...\n")

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat                  = mat_heat_sat,
  color                = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200),
  breaks               = seq(-zlim, zlim, length.out = 201),
  cluster_rows         = TRUE,      # Clustering hiérarchique des gènes
  cluster_cols         = FALSE,     # Colonnes ordonnées par type tumoral
  show_rownames        = N_HEATMAP <= 40,  # Noms des gènes si pas trop nombreux
  show_colnames        = FALSE,
  annotation_col       = annot_col,
  annotation_colors    = annot_colors,
  annotation_names_col = FALSE,
  scale                = "none",    # Z-score déjà appliqué (X_tr = centré-réduit)
  fontsize_row         = 6,
  fontsize             = 8,
  border_color         = NA,
  main                 = sprintf(
    "Expression des %d biomarqueurs — TCGA PANCAN (Train set, n=%d)\nZ-score | clustering hiérarchique (Ward D2) | ordonné par type tumoral",
    N_HEATMAP, nrow(X_tr)
  ),
  treeheight_row       = 30,
  cutree_rows          = 5,         # Séparer en 5 groupes (≈ 5 types tumoraux)
  gaps_col             = cumsum(table(y_ordered)[-length(table(y_ordered))]),
  silent               = TRUE
)

# ── 6. Statistiques de validation ────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── VALIDATION DE LA SÉPARABILITÉ ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Variance entre groupes / variance totale par gène (η² ANOVA) :\n"))

eta2_vals <- sapply(seq_len(N_HEATMAP), function(i) {
  g <- as.numeric(mat_heat[i, ])
  aov_res <- tryCatch(aov(g ~ y_ordered), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(aov_res)) return(NA_real_)
  ss <- summary(aov_res)[[1]][, "Sum Sq"]
  ss[1] / sum(ss)  # η² = SS_between / SS_total
})

cat(sprintf("    η² médian : %.3f  (proportion de variance entre groupes)\n",
            median(eta2_vals, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("    η² max    : %.3f  (gène le plus discriminant dans le panel)\n",
            max(eta2_vals, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("    η² > 0.7  : %d/%d gènes (forte séparabilité)\n",
            sum(eta2_vals > 0.7, na.rm = TRUE), N_HEATMAP))

# Sauvegarder
saveRDS(list(eta2 = eta2_vals, n_heatmap = N_HEATMAP),
        "outputs/metrics/biomarker_eta2.rds")

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ Phase 6.1 — Heatmap générée\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

```{r biomarker-violins, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Distributions d'expression des 12 biomarqueurs les plus discriminants (train set). Un bon biomarqueur présente des distributions non-chevauchantes entre types tumoraux."}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  )

# Phase 7 — Entraînement des Modèles ML

## 7.1 Données du panel consensus

```{r ml-data-prep}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Phase 7.1 — Données du panel consensus — Préparation finale pour le ML
#
# OBJECTIF : Préparer les matrices finales pour l'entraînement des modèles
# en utilisant le panel de biomarqueurs validé statistiquement.
#
# CE BLOC UTILISE :
#   - final_panel_idx : indices des gènes du panel (issus de la stability selection)
#   - X_train, X_val, X_test : matrices originales (espace complet)
#
# PRODUIT :
#   - X_tr, X_vl, X_te : matrices normalisées (z-score) pour le ML
#
# ANTI-DATA LEAKAGE :
#   - StandardScaler calculé sur X_TRAIN uniquement
#   - Paramètres (μ, σ) réappliqués à X_val et X_test
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  7.1 DONNÉES DU PANEL CONSENSUS\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# ── Vérification de l'existence du panel ────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("final_panel_idx")) {
  # Tentative de chargement depuis le fichier sauvegardé
  if (file.exists("outputs/metrics/final_panel_indices.rds")) {
    final_panel_idx <- readRDS("outputs/metrics/final_panel_indices.rds")
    cat("  ✓ Panel chargé depuis outputs/metrics/final_panel_indices.rds\n")
  } else {
    stop("final_panel_idx introuvable. Exécuter d'abord la stability selection.")
  }
}

FINAL_PANEL_SIZE <- length(final_panel_idx)

# Vérification rapide des indices
stopifnot(all(final_panel_idx >= 1))
stopifnot(all(final_panel_idx <= ncol(X_train)))
stopifnot(length(unique(final_panel_idx)) == FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)

cat(sprintf("  Panel consensus           : %d gènes biomarqueurs\n", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE))
cat(sprintf("  Critères                  : MAD > Q1 + ANOVA sig. + MI sig. + Boruta + Stability π ≥ 0.60\n"))

# ── Vérification des matrices sources ───────────────────────────────────────
# S'assurer que X_train, X_val, X_test existent
if (!exists("X_train") || !exists("X_val") || !exists("X_test")) {
  stop("Matrices X_train, X_val, X_test introuvables. Vérifier le chargement des données.")
}

cat(sprintf("\n  Matrices sources :\n"))
cat(sprintf("    X_train : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_train), ncol(X_train)))
cat(sprintf("    X_val   : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_val),   ncol(X_val)))
cat(sprintf("    X_test  : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_test),  ncol(X_test)))

# ── Extraction du panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Extraire uniquement les colonnes correspondant au panel final
X_train_panel <- X_train[, final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE]
X_val_panel   <- X_val[,   final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE]
X_test_panel  <- X_test[,  final_panel_idx, drop = FALSE]

cat(sprintf("\n  Après extraction du panel :\n"))
cat(sprintf("    X_train_panel : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_train_panel), ncol(X_train_panel)))
cat(sprintf("    X_val_panel   : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_val_panel),   ncol(X_val_panel)))
cat(sprintf("    X_test_panel  : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_test_panel),  ncol(X_test_panel)))

# ── StandardScaler sur X_TRAIN uniquement ───────────────────────────────────
# Calcul de la moyenne et de l'écart-type SUR LE TRAIN SEULEMENT
mu_panel  <- colMeans(X_train_panel, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_panel  <- apply(X_train_panel, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# Protection contre les gènes constants (sd = 0)
n_constant <- sum(sd_panel == 0)
if (n_constant > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  %d gène(s) constant(s) → sd fixée à 1\n", n_constant))
  sd_panel[sd_panel == 0] <- 1
}

# Application du z-score
X_tr <- scale(X_train_panel, center = mu_panel, scale = sd_panel)
X_vl <- scale(X_val_panel,   center = mu_panel, scale = sd_panel)
X_te <- scale(X_test_panel,  center = mu_panel, scale = sd_panel)

cat(sprintf("\n  StandardScaler appliqué :\n"))
cat(sprintf("    μ (moyenne des moyennes par gène) : %.6f\n", mean(mu_panel)))
cat(sprintf("    σ (moyenne des écarts-types)      : %.6f\n", mean(sd_panel)))

# ── Vérification de la normalisation ─────────────────────────────────────────
# X_tr doit avoir moyenne ≈ 0 et sd ≈ 1 pour chaque gène
tr_means <- colMeans(X_tr)
tr_sds   <- apply(X_tr, 2, sd)

cat(sprintf("\n  Vérification de la normalisation (X_tr) :\n"))
cat(sprintf("    Moyenne des moyennes : %.8f (attendu : 0)\n", mean(tr_means)))
cat(sprintf("    Moyenne des sd       : %.8f (attendu : 1)\n", mean(tr_sds)))
cat(sprintf("    Max |moyenne|        : %.6f\n", max(abs(tr_means))))

if (mean(abs(tr_means)) > 0.001) {
  warning("X_tr ne semble pas parfaitement centré. Vérifier les données.")
}

# ── Rapport final ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── MATRICES FINALES POUR LE ML ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Panel consensus : %d gènes biomarqueurs\n", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE))
cat(sprintf("  %-10s : %d × %d\n", "X_tr", nrow(X_tr), ncol(X_tr)))
cat(sprintf("  %-10s : %d × %d\n", "X_vl", nrow(X_vl), ncol(X_vl)))
cat(sprintf("  %-10s : %d × %d\n", "X_te", nrow(X_te), ncol(X_te)))

# ── Vérification de l'absence de NA ──────────────────────────────────────────
na_tr <- sum(is.na(X_tr))
na_vl <- sum(is.na(X_vl))
na_te <- sum(is.na(X_te))

cat(sprintf("\n  NA dans X_tr : %d\n", na_tr))
cat(sprintf("  NA dans X_vl : %d\n", na_vl))
cat(sprintf("  NA dans X_te : %d\n", na_te))

if (na_tr + na_vl + na_te > 0) {
  warning("NA détectés ! Vérifier les données d'entrée.")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ Aucune valeur manquante détectée\n")
}

# ── Distribution des classes (rappel) ────────────────────────────────────────
if (exists("y_train") && exists("y_val") && exists("y_test")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  Distribution des classes :\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s %8s %8s %8s\n", "Classe", "Train", "Val", "Test"))
  cat(sprintf("  %s\n", paste(rep("─", 40), collapse = "")))
  
  classes_communes <- unique(c(levels(y_train), levels(y_val), levels(y_test)))
  for (cl in sort(classes_communes)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-12s %8d %8d %8d\n", 
                cl, 
                sum(y_train == cl), 
                sum(y_val == cl), 
                sum(y_test == cl)))
  }
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s %8d %8d %8d\n", 
              "Total", length(y_train), length(y_val), length(y_test)))
}

# ── Noms des gènes du panel (pour référence) ─────────────────────────────────
panel_genes <- colnames(X_train)[final_panel_idx]
cat(sprintf("\n  10 premiers gènes du panel : %s\n", 
            paste(panel_genes[1:min(10, length(panel_genes))], collapse = ", ")))

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ 7.1 Terminé — Matrices ML prêtes\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

## 7.2 Fonction de métriques complètes (12 métriques)


```{r metrics-function}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 12 MÉTRIQUES DE CLASSIFICATION MULTICLASSE
#
# MÉTRIQUES IMPLÉMENTÉES :
#   Discrimination  : Accuracy, Balanced Accuracy, MCC, F1 macro, Kappa, G-mean
#   Probabilistes   : AUC-ROC macro, PR-AUC macro, LogLoss, Brier Score, BSS
#   Calibration     : ECE (Expected Calibration Error)
#
# RÉFÉRENCES :
#   MCC multiclasse : Gorodkin (2004) Bioinformatics
#   G-mean          : Kubat & Matwin (1997) ICML
#   ECE             : Naeini et al. (2015) AAAI
#   Brier Score     : Brier (1950) Monthly Weather Review
#   BSS             : Wilks (2011) Statistical Methods in Atmospheric Sciences
#
# CORRECTIONS apportées :
#   ✓ PR-AUC calculé avec PRROC::pr.curve() (plus précis que l'interpolation manuelle)
#   ✓ ECE avec bins de taille égale (et non égaux en fréquence)
#   ✓ G-mean protégé contre les divisions par zéro
#   ✓ Brier Score multiclasse corrigé (formule standardisée)
#   ✓ Gestion robuste des erreurs avec messages de diagnostic
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

compute_metrics <- function(y_true, y_pred, y_proba) {
  # ── Validation des entrées ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # y_true  : facteur de classes (ex: factor avec levels = CLASSES)
  # y_pred  : facteur de classes (mêmes levels)
  # y_proba : matrice n × K de probabilités (colonnes = CLASSES)
  
  # Vérification des types
  stopifnot(is.factor(y_true))
  stopifnot(is.factor(y_pred))
  stopifnot(is.matrix(y_proba) || is.data.frame(y_proba))
  stopifnot(all(levels(y_true) == levels(y_pred)))
  
  # Conversion en matrice si data.frame
  if (is.data.frame(y_proba)) {
    y_proba <- as.matrix(y_proba)
  }
  
  # Dimensions
  K <- length(levels(y_true))
  n <- length(y_true)
  
  # Vérifier que les colonnes de y_proba sont dans le bon ordre
  stopifnot(ncol(y_proba) == K)
  colnames(y_proba) <- levels(y_true)
  
  # Conversion en entiers pour la binarisation
  y_int <- as.integer(y_true)
  
  # Matrice binaire one-hot (n × K)
  y_bin <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = K)
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    y_bin[, k] <- as.integer(y_int == k)
  }
  colnames(y_bin) <- levels(y_true)
  
  # ── 1. Accuracy ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  acc <- mean(y_true == y_pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ── 2. Matthews Correlation Coefficient ────────────────────────────────────
  # Réf : Gorodkin (2004) — version multiclasse
  mcc_val <- tryCatch({
    yardstick::mcc_vec(truth = y_true, estimate = y_pred)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("MCC : erreur de calcul — ", e$message)
    NA_real_
  })
  
  # ── 3. F1 macro ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  f1_mac <- tryCatch({
    yardstick::f_meas_vec(truth = y_true, estimate = y_pred, estimator = "macro")
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("F1 macro : erreur de calcul — ", e$message)
    NA_real_
  })
  
  # ── 4. Balanced Accuracy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Moyenne des sensibilités (recall) par classe
  bal_acc <- tryCatch({
    yardstick::bal_accuracy_vec(truth = y_true, estimate = y_pred)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Balanced Accuracy : erreur de calcul — ", e$message)
    NA_real_
  })
  
  # ── 5. Cohen's Kappa ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kappa_val <- tryCatch({
    yardstick::kap_vec(truth = y_true, estimate = y_pred)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Kappa : erreur de calcul — ", e$message)
    NA_real_
  })
  
  # ── 6. AUC-ROC macro (One-vs-Rest) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  # Via pROC::multiclass.roc (Hand & Till, 2001)
  auc_roc <- tryCatch({
    roc_multi <- pROC::multiclass.roc(
      response  = y_true,
      predictor = y_proba,
      levels    = levels(y_true),
      quiet     = TRUE
    )
    as.numeric(roc_multi$auc)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Fallback : calcul manuel macro OvR
    warning("AUC-ROC multiclasse : erreur — ", e$message, " → calcul manuel")
    aucs <- vapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
      tryCatch({
        pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y_bin[, k], y_proba[, k], 
                           quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))
      }, error = function(e2) NA_real_)
    }, numeric(1))
    mean(aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # ── 7. PR-AUC macro ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # CORRECTION : utilise PRROC::pr.curve() au lieu de l'interpolation manuelle
  # qui était approximative
  auc_pr <- tryCatch({
    pr_aucs <- vapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
      # Vérifier qu'il y a au moins un positif
      if (sum(y_bin[, k]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      
      pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
        scores.class0 = y_proba[y_bin[, k] == 1, k],
        scores.class1 = y_proba[y_bin[, k] == 0, k],
        curve = FALSE
      )
      pr$auc.integral
    }, numeric(1))
    mean(pr_aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("PR-AUC : erreur — ", e$message, " → fallback manuel")
    # Fallback : calcul manuel simplifié
    mean(vapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
      if (sum(y_bin[, k]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      roc_k <- tryCatch(
        pROC::roc(y_bin[, k], y_proba[, k], quiet = TRUE),
        error = function(e2) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(roc_k)) return(NA_real_)
      # Interpolation trapèze (meilleure que rien)
      tpr <- roc_k$sensitivities
      ppv <- roc_k$precisions
      if (length(tpr) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      idx <- order(tpr)
      sum(diff(tpr[idx]) * (ppv[idx][-1] + ppv[idx][-length(ppv[idx])]) / 2, 
          na.rm = TRUE)
    }, numeric(1)), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # ── 8. Log-Loss (Cross-Entropy) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  eps <- 1e-15  # Pour éviter log(0)
  y_proba_clipped <- pmax(pmin(y_proba, 1 - eps), eps)
  ll <- -mean(rowSums(y_bin * log(y_proba_clipped), na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ── 9. Brier Score multiclasse ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Formule standard : BS = (1/n) Σᵢ Σₖ (pᵢₖ - yᵢₖ)²
  bs <- mean(rowSums((y_proba - y_bin)^2, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ── 10. Brier Skill Score ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # BSS = 1 - BS / BS_ref
  # BS_ref = Σₖ πₖ(1 - πₖ) où πₖ = prévalence de la classe k
  prev <- colMeans(y_bin, na.rm = TRUE)  # Prévalences observées
  bs_ref <- sum(prev * (1 - prev), na.rm = TRUE)
  bss <- if (bs_ref > 0) 1 - bs / bs_ref else 0
  
  # ── 11. G-mean (Geometric Mean of Recalls) ─────────────────────────────────
  # Réf : Kubat & Matwin (1997)
  cm <- table(y_true, y_pred)
  
  # S'assurer que toutes les classes sont présentes dans la matrice
  cm_full <- matrix(0, nrow = K, ncol = K)
  rownames(cm_full) <- levels(y_true)
  colnames(cm_full) <- levels(y_true)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cm))) {
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(cm))) {
      cm_full[rownames(cm)[i], colnames(cm)[j]] <- cm[i, j]
    }
  }
  
  # Calcul des recalls (sensibilités) par classe
  recalls <- diag(cm_full) / (rowSums(cm_full) + 1e-15)
  
  # G-mean = (∏ₖ recallₖ)^(1/K)
  # Protection : si un recall = 0, G-mean = 0
  if (any(recalls == 0)) {
    gmean <- 0
  } else {
    gmean <- exp(mean(log(recalls)))  # Équivalent à prod(recalls)^(1/K)
  }
  
  # ── 12. ECE (Expected Calibration Error) ───────────────────────────────────
  # CORRECTION : bins de taille ÉGALE (pas égaux en fréquence)
  # Réf : Naeini et al. (2015) AAAI
  n_bins <- 10
  bin_boundaries <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)
  
  ece_total <- 0
  n_total <- 0
  
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    true_k <- y_bin[, k]
    prob_k <- y_proba[, k]
    
    for (b in seq_len(n_bins)) {
      # Masque pour ce bin
      in_bin <- prob_k >= bin_boundaries[b] & prob_k < bin_boundaries[b + 1]
      # Dernier bin inclut la borne supérieure
      if (b == n_bins) {
        in_bin <- prob_k >= bin_boundaries[b] & prob_k <= bin_boundaries[b + 1]
      }
      
      n_bin <- sum(in_bin)
      if (n_bin == 0) next
      
      # Accuracy dans ce bin vs confiance moyenne
      acc_bin <- mean(true_k[in_bin])
      conf_bin <- mean(prob_k[in_bin])
      
      ece_total <- ece_total + n_bin * abs(acc_bin - conf_bin)
      n_total <- n_total + n_bin
    }
  }
  
  ece <- if (n_total > 0) ece_total / n_total else 0
  
  # ── Retour ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list(
    Accuracy  = acc,
    BalAcc    = bal_acc,
    MCC       = mcc_val,
    Kappa     = kappa_val,
    F1_macro  = f1_mac,
    AUC_ROC   = auc_roc,
    PR_AUC    = auc_pr,
    LogLoss   = ll,
    Brier     = bs,
    BSS       = bss,
    Gmean     = gmean,
    ECE       = ece
  )
}

cat("✓ Fonction compute_metrics() définie — 12 métriques\n")
cat("  Discrimination  : Accuracy, BalAcc, MCC, F1_macro, Kappa, Gmean\n")
cat("  Probabilistes   : AUC_ROC, PR_AUC, LogLoss, Brier, BSS\n")
cat("  Calibration     : ECE (10 bins égaux)\n")
```

## 7.3 Entraînement des 7 modèles

```{r train-models}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7.3 ENTRAÎNEMENT DES 7 MODÈLES — RandomizedSearchCV
#
# AVANTAGE DU RANDOMIZED SEARCH vs GRID SEARCH :
#   - Explore plus efficacement l'espace des hyperparamètres
#   - Échantillonne aléatoirement N combinaisons (pas exhaustif)
#   - Permet de tester des distributions continues (pas seulement discret)
#   - Plus rapide à performance égale (Bergstra & Bengio, 2012, JMLR)
#
# PROTOCOLE :
#   - 50 combinaisons aléatoires par modèle (sauf MLP : 30)
#   - Validation interne : 5-fold CV répété 3 fois
#   - Métrique d'optimisation : AUC macro
#   - Distributions : uniforme pour discret, log-uniforme pour continu
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  7.3 ENTRAÎNEMENT — RandomizedSearchCV (50 itérations)\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

set.seed(SEED)

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_RANDOM_COMBOS <- 50  # Nombre de combinaisons aléatoires par modèle

# Validation croisée interne (identique pour tous les modèles)
cv_inner <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 3,
  classProbs      = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = caret::multiClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter     = FALSE,
  allowParallel   = TRUE,
  search          = "random"  # ← Randomized Search !
)

# ── Préparation des labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!is.factor(y_train)) y_train <- factor(y_train, levels = CLASSES)
if (!is.factor(y_val))   y_val   <- factor(y_val,   levels = CLASSES)
if (!is.factor(y_test))  y_test  <- factor(y_test,  levels = CLASSES)

cat(sprintf("  Stratégie          : RandomizedSearchCV\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Combinaisons       : %d par modèle\n", N_RANDOM_COMBOS))
cat(sprintf("  CV interne         : 5-fold × 3 répétitions\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Métrique           : AUC macro\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Classes            : %s\n\n", paste(CLASSES, collapse = ", ")))

# ── Conteneurs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
trained_models <- list()
metrics_val    <- list()
training_times <- list()
best_params    <- list()

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FONCTION D'ENTRAÎNEMENT AVEC RANDOMIZED SEARCH
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

train_randomized <- function(name, method, tune_length = N_RANDOM_COMBOS, 
                              extra_args = list(), custom_grid = NULL) {
  
  cat(sprintf("  ── [%s] ──\n", name))
  
  t0 <- proc.time()
  
  # Si une grille personnalisée est fournie, échantillonner dedans
  if (!is.null(custom_grid)) {
    # Échantillonner aléatoirement N combinaisons dans la grande grille
    n_total <- nrow(custom_grid)
    n_sample <- min(N_RANDOM_COMBOS, n_total)
    sampled_idx <- sample(n_total, n_sample)
    sampled_grid <- custom_grid[sampled_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    cat(sprintf("  Grille échantillonnée : %d / %d combinaisons\n", 
                n_sample, n_total))
    
    # Remplacer la grille dans le contrôle
    ctrl_random <- cv_inner
    ctrl_random$search <- "grid"  # On fournit la grille déjà échantillonnée
    
    train_args <- c(
      list(
        x         = X_tr,
        y         = y_train,
        method    = method,
        trControl = ctrl_random,
        tuneGrid  = sampled_grid,
        metric    = "AUC"
      ),
      extra_args
    )
  } else {
    # Utiliser le random search natif de caret
    cat(sprintf("  Recherche aléatoire : %d combinaisons\n", tune_length))
    
    train_args <- c(
      list(
        x          = X_tr,
        y          = y_train,
        method     = method,
        trControl  = cv_inner,
        tuneLength = tune_length,  # ← Nombre de combinaisons aléatoires
        metric     = "AUC"
      ),
      extra_args
    )
  }
  
  # Entraînement avec gestion d'erreur
  m <- tryCatch({
    set.seed(SEED)
    do.call(caret::train, train_args)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ ERREUR : %s\n", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  dt <- (proc.time() - t0)["elapsed"]
  
  if (is.null(m)) {
    trained_models[[name]] <<- NULL
    metrics_val[[name]]    <<- list(
      Accuracy = NA, BalAcc = NA, MCC = NA, Kappa = NA, F1_macro = NA,
      AUC_ROC = NA, PR_AUC = NA, LogLoss = NA, Brier = NA, BSS = NA,
      Gmean = NA, ECE = NA
    )
    training_times[[name]] <<- dt
    best_params[[name]]    <<- NULL
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Prédictions sur validation
  y_pred  <- predict(m, X_vl)
  y_proba <- predict(m, X_vl, type = "prob")
  y_proba <- y_proba[, CLASSES, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Métriques
  met <- compute_metrics(y_val, y_pred, as.matrix(y_proba))
  
  # Affichage
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-20s | MCC=%.4f | AUC=%.4f | BalAcc=%.4f | F1=%.4f | %.1fs\n",
              name, met$MCC, met$AUC_ROC, met$BalAcc, met$F1_macro, dt))
  cat(sprintf("    Brier=%.4f | BSS=%.4f | ECE=%.4f | Gmean=%.4f\n",
              met$Brier, met$BSS, met$ECE, met$Gmean))
  
  # Meilleurs hyperparamètres
  cat("    Meilleurs paramètres : ")
  cat(paste(names(m$bestTune), "=", as.character(m$bestTune), collapse = ", "))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Stockage
  trained_models[[name]] <<- m
  metrics_val[[name]]    <<- met
  training_times[[name]] <<- dt
  best_params[[name]]    <<- m$bestTune
  
  # Sauvegarde checkpoint
  saveRDS(list(trained_models = trained_models, 
               metrics_val    = metrics_val,
               best_params    = best_params),
          "outputs/models/models_checkpoint.rds")
  
  return(invisible(m))
}

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. RÉGRESSION LOGISTIQUE ELASTICNET
# Distribution log-uniforme pour lambda, uniforme pour alpha
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Générer une grande grille pour échantillonner
glmnet_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  alpha  = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),     # 21 valeurs
  lambda = 10^seq(-4, 1, length.out = 50)  # 50 valeurs
)  # Total : 1050 combinaisons → on échantillonne 50

train_randomized(
  name   = "LogisticReg",
  method = "glmnet",
  custom_grid = glmnet_full_grid,
  extra_args = list(family = "multinomial", maxit = 1000)
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. SVM LINÉAIRE
# Distribution log-uniforme pour C
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

svm_lin_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  cost = 10^seq(-4, 2, length.out = 50)
)

train_randomized(
  name   = "SVM_Lin",
  method = "svmLinear2",
  custom_grid = svm_lin_full_grid
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. SVM RBF
# Distribution log-uniforme pour C et sigma
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

svm_rbf_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  C     = 10^seq(-3, 3, length.out = 30),
  sigma = 10^seq(-4, 0, length.out = 25)
)  # Total : 750 → échantillonne 50

train_randomized(
  name   = "SVM_RBF",
  method = "svmRadial",
  custom_grid = svm_rbf_full_grid
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. K-NEAREST NEIGHBORS
# Distribution uniforme pour k
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

knn_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  kmax     = seq(3, 31, by = 2),     # 15 valeurs
  distance = 2,
  kernel   = c("optimal", "rectangular", "triangular", "epanechnikov", 
               "biweight", "triweight", "cos", "inv", "gaussian")
)  # Total : 135 → échantillonne 50

train_randomized(
  name   = "KNN",
  method = "kknn",
  custom_grid = knn_full_grid
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. RANDOM FOREST
# Distribution uniforme pour mtry, splitrule, min.node.size
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

rf_mtry_range <- unique(round(seq(
  max(2, floor(sqrt(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE) * 0.5)),
  min(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE, floor(sqrt(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE) * 2)),
  length.out = 15
)))
rf_mtry_range <- rf_mtry_range[rf_mtry_range >= 2 & rf_mtry_range <= FINAL_PANEL_SIZE]

rf_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry           = rf_mtry_range,
  splitrule      = c("gini", "extratrees", "hellinger"),
  min.node.size  = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10)
)

train_randomized(
  name   = "RandomForest",
  method = "ranger",
  custom_grid = rf_full_grid,
  extra_args = list(
    num.trees   = 500,
    importance  = "impurity",
    num.threads = max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L),
    verbose     = FALSE
  )
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. XGBOOST — VERSION CORRIGÉE
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
# CORRECTIONS :
#   1. verbosity = 0 retiré de extra_args → passé via nthread dans xgb.control
#      ou ignoré (caret gère déjà la verbosité via verbose = FALSE)
#   2. X_tr converti en data.frame avec colnames valides
#      (xgbTree exige des noms sans caractères spéciaux)
#   3. Grille vérifiée : les 7 paramètres DOIVENT correspondre exactement
#      aux noms attendus par caret::train(method = "xgbTree")
#   4. objective fixé à "multi:softprob" pour multiclasse

# ── Vérification des noms de colonnes ────────────────────────────────────────
# xgbTree échoue si les noms ont des espaces ou caractères spéciaux
X_tr_xgb <- X_tr
colnames(X_tr_xgb) <- make.names(colnames(X_tr_xgb), unique = TRUE)
X_vl_xgb <- X_vl
colnames(X_vl_xgb) <- make.names(colnames(X_vl_xgb), unique = TRUE)

# ── Grille corrigée ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Noms EXACTS requis par caret pour xgbTree :
# nrounds, max_depth, eta, gamma, colsample_bytree, min_child_weight, subsample
xgb_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  nrounds          = c(50L, 100L, 200L, 300L, 500L),
  max_depth        = c(2L, 3L, 4L, 6L, 8L),
  eta              = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3),
  gamma            = c(0, 0.1, 0.5, 1),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 1.0),
  min_child_weight = c(1L, 3L, 5L),
  subsample        = c(0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0)
)

cat(sprintf("  Grille XGBoost totale : %d combinaisons\n", nrow(xgb_full_grid)))

# Échantillonnage
set.seed(SEED)
n_xgb <- min(N_RANDOM_COMBOS, nrow(xgb_full_grid))
xgb_sampled_grid <- xgb_full_grid[sample(nrow(xgb_full_grid), n_xgb), ]

cat(sprintf("  Grille échantillonnée : %d combinaisons\n", n_xgb))

# ── Contrôle CV adapté pour XGBoost ──────────────────────────────────────────
cv_xgb <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 3,
  classProbs      = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = caret::multiClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter     = FALSE,
  allowParallel   = TRUE,
  search          = "grid"   # grille déjà échantillonnée → mode grid
)

# ── Entraînement XGBoost ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("  ── [XGBoost] ──\n")
cat(sprintf("  Grille échantillonnée : %d / %d combinaisons\n",
            n_xgb, nrow(xgb_full_grid)))

t0 <- proc.time()

xgb_model <- tryCatch({
  set.seed(SEED)
  caret::train(
    x         = X_tr_xgb,
    y         = y_train,
    method    = "xgbTree",
    trControl = cv_xgb,
    tuneGrid  = xgb_sampled_grid,
    metric    = "AUC",
    # Paramètres fixes passés directement (pas via extra_args)
    nthread   = max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L),
    objective = "multi:softprob",
    eval_metric = "mlogloss",
    verbose   = 0   # Paramètre xgboost natif — supprime les logs internes
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ ERREUR XGBoost : %s\n", e$message))
  NULL
})

dt_xgb <- (proc.time() - t0)["elapsed"]

if (!is.null(xgb_model)) {
  # Prédictions sur validation avec les mêmes noms de colonnes
  y_pred_xgb  <- predict(xgb_model, X_vl_xgb)
  y_proba_xgb <- predict(xgb_model, X_vl_xgb, type = "prob")
  y_proba_xgb <- y_proba_xgb[, CLASSES, drop = FALSE]

  met_xgb <- compute_metrics(y_val, y_pred_xgb, as.matrix(y_proba_xgb))

  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-20s | MCC=%.4f | AUC=%.4f | BalAcc=%.4f | F1=%.4f | %.1fs\n",
              "XGBoost", met_xgb$MCC, met_xgb$AUC_ROC,
              met_xgb$BalAcc, met_xgb$F1_macro, dt_xgb))
  cat(sprintf("    Brier=%.4f | BSS=%.4f | ECE=%.4f | Gmean=%.4f\n",
              met_xgb$Brier, met_xgb$BSS, met_xgb$ECE, met_xgb$Gmean))
  cat("    Meilleurs paramètres : ")
  cat(paste(names(xgb_model$bestTune), "=",
            as.character(xgb_model$bestTune), collapse = ", "))
  cat("\n")

  trained_models[["XGBoost"]] <- xgb_model
  metrics_val[["XGBoost"]]   <- met_xgb
  best_params[["XGBoost"]]   <- xgb_model$bestTune

} else {
  # Fallback : remplir avec NA pour ne pas bloquer le tableau comparatif
  trained_models[["XGBoost"]] <- NULL
  metrics_val[["XGBoost"]]    <- list(
    Accuracy = NA, BalAcc = NA, MCC = NA, Kappa = NA, F1_macro = NA,
    AUC_ROC  = NA, PR_AUC = NA, LogLoss = NA, Brier = NA, BSS = NA,
    Gmean    = NA, ECE    = NA
  )
  best_params[["XGBoost"]] <- NULL
  cat("  → XGBoost en échec — ligne NA dans le tableau comparatif\n")
}

training_times[["XGBoost"]] <- dt_xgb

# Checkpoint
saveRDS(list(trained_models = trained_models,
             metrics_val    = metrics_val,
             best_params    = best_params),
        "outputs/models/models_checkpoint.rds")

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. MLP (RÉSEAU DE NEURONES)
# Distribution log-uniforme pour decay, uniforme pour size
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

mlp_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  size  = c(10, 20, 30, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200),
  decay = 10^seq(-5, -1, length.out = 15)
)  # Total : 120 → échantillonne 30 (MLP est plus lent)

train_randomized(
  name   = "MLP",
  method = "nnet",
  tune_length = 30,  # Moins de combinaisons car MLP est lent
  custom_grid = mlp_full_grid,
  extra_args = list(
    MaxNWts = 10000,
    maxit   = 200,
    trace   = FALSE
  )
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TABLEAU COMPARATIF FINAL
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  RÉSULTATS — VALIDATION SET (RandomizedSearchCV)\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Construire le tableau
metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(metrics_val), function(nm) {
  met <- metrics_val[[nm]]
  bp  <- best_params[[nm]]
  
  data.frame(
    Model      = nm,
    Accuracy   = met$Accuracy,
    BalAcc     = met$BalAcc,
    MCC        = met$MCC,
    Kappa      = met$Kappa,
    F1_macro   = met$F1_macro,
    AUC_ROC    = met$AUC_ROC,
    PR_AUC     = met$PR_AUC,
    LogLoss    = met$LogLoss,
    Brier      = met$Brier,
    BSS        = met$BSS,
    Gmean      = met$Gmean,
    ECE        = met$ECE,
    Temps_s    = training_times[[nm]],
    BestParams = if (!is.null(bp)) {
      paste(names(bp), "=", as.character(bp), collapse = "; ")
    } else { "Échec" },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Trier par MCC décroissant
metrics_df <- metrics_df[order(metrics_df$MCC, decreasing = TRUE), ]
rownames(metrics_df) <- NULL

# Arrondir
numeric_cols <- sapply(metrics_df, is.numeric)
metrics_display <- metrics_df
metrics_display[numeric_cols] <- round(metrics_display[numeric_cols], 4)

# Afficher tableau complet
print(metrics_display, row.names = FALSE)

# ── Meilleur modèle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
best_model_name <- metrics_df$Model[1]
cat(sprintf("\n  ★ Meilleur modèle : %s\n", best_model_name))
cat(sprintf("    MCC  = %.4f\n", metrics_df$MCC[1]))
cat(sprintf("    AUC  = %.4f\n", metrics_df$AUC_ROC[1]))
cat(sprintf("    BSS  = %.4f\n", metrics_df$BSS[1]))
cat(sprintf("    ECE  = %.4f\n", metrics_df$ECE[1]))

# ── Tableau simplifié pour publication ───────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  ── Métriques principales (pour article) ──\n")
metrics_display |>
  select(Model, MCC, AUC_ROC, BalAcc, F1_macro, BSS, ECE, Temps_s) |>
  print(row.names = FALSE)

# ── Meilleurs hyperparamètres ────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  ── Meilleurs hyperparamètres par modèle ──\n")
for (nm in names(best_params)) {
  if (!is.null(best_params[[nm]])) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-20s : %s\n", nm, 
                paste(names(best_params[[nm]]), "=", 
                      as.character(best_params[[nm]]), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAUVEGARDE
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

saveRDS(trained_models, "outputs/models/all_trained_models.rds")
saveRDS(metrics_val,    "outputs/models/metrics_val_list.rds")
saveRDS(best_params,    "outputs/models/best_params.rds")
saveRDS(trained_models[[best_model_name]], "outputs/models/best_model.rds")

write.csv(metrics_df, "outputs/metrics/metrics_val_all_models.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\n  💾 Fichiers sauvegardés :\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/models/all_trained_models.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/models/best_model.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/models/best_params.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/metrics_val_all_models.csv\n"))

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ 7.3 Terminé — RandomizedSearchCV\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

## 7.3.2 Entrainement avec API native (XGBoost)

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# XGBOOST — VERSION CORRIGÉE POUR XGBoost ≥ 2.0 + R 4.5.2
#
# CORRECTIONS APPLIQUÉES :
#   1. Callback R pur (sans cb.evaluation.log non exporté) via environnement
#      partagé : capture les scores à chaque itération dans score_env$log
#   2. get_best_logloss_xgb() lit score_env$log au lieu de evaluation_log
#   3. Détection automatique byrow via vérification rowSums
#   4. CV interne : nrounds fixe, early_stopping uniquement pour le modèle final
#   5. CLASSES_XGB aligné sur levels(y_train)
# =============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  XGBOOST — API native (xgb.train, XGBoost ≥ 2.0)\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

set.seed(SEED)

# ── DIAGNOSTIC : ordre des classes (0‑based) ──────────────────────────────────
CLASSES_XGB <- levels(y_train)
cat("  Ordre classes XGBoost (0-based) :\n")
for (i in seq_along(CLASSES_XGB)) {
  cat(sprintf("    %d → %s (n_train=%d, n_val=%d)\n",
              i-1L, CLASSES_XGB[i],
              sum(y_train == CLASSES_XGB[i]),
              sum(y_val   == CLASSES_XGB[i])))
}
stopifnot(setequal(CLASSES_XGB, CLASSES))

# ── Préparation données ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_xgb_train <- as.integer(y_train) - 1L
y_xgb_val   <- as.integer(y_val)   - 1L

stopifnot(min(y_xgb_train) == 0L)
stopifnot(max(y_xgb_train) == length(CLASSES_XGB) - 1L)

X_xgb_train <- matrix(as.numeric(X_tr), nrow = nrow(X_tr), ncol = ncol(X_tr))
X_xgb_val   <- matrix(as.numeric(X_vl), nrow = nrow(X_vl), ncol = ncol(X_vl))
colnames(X_xgb_train) <- make.names(colnames(X_tr), unique = TRUE)
colnames(X_xgb_val)   <- colnames(X_xgb_train)

dtrain_xgb <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = X_xgb_train, label = y_xgb_train)
dval_xgb   <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = X_xgb_val,   label = y_xgb_val)

cat(sprintf("\n  X_train : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_xgb_train), ncol(X_xgb_train)))
cat(sprintf("  X_val   : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_xgb_val),   ncol(X_xgb_val)))

# ── Paramètres fixes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
params_xgb_fixed <- list(
  booster     = "gbtree",
  objective   = "multi:softprob",
  num_class   = length(CLASSES_XGB),
  eval_metric = "mlogloss",
  nthread     = max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L),
  verbosity   = 0L
)

# ── Grille ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(SEED)
xgb_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth        = c(2L, 3L, 4L, 6L),
  eta              = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3),
  gamma            = c(0, 0.1, 0.5),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.7, 0.8, 1.0),
  min_child_weight = c(1L, 3L, 5L),
  subsample        = c(0.7, 0.8, 1.0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

N_RANDOM_XGB <- 30L
sampled_xgb  <- xgb_full_grid[sample(nrow(xgb_full_grid), N_RANDOM_XGB), ]
cat(sprintf("  Grille : %d / %d combinaisons\n", N_RANDOM_XGB, nrow(xgb_full_grid)))

# ── CV 5‑fold manuel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_FOLDS_XGB   <- 5L
NROUNDS_CV    <- 100L
NROUNDS_FINAL <- 500L

folds_xgb      <- caret::createFolds(y_train, k = N_FOLDS_XGB,
                                      list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
cv_results_xgb <- vector("list", N_RANDOM_XGB)

cat("  RandomizedSearch en cours...\n")
pb_xgb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0L, max = N_RANDOM_XGB, style = 3)

for (i in seq_len(N_RANDOM_XGB)) {
  params_i     <- c(params_xgb_fixed, as.list(sampled_xgb[i, , drop = FALSE]))
  fold_logloss <- numeric(N_FOLDS_XGB)

  for (f in seq_len(N_FOLDS_XGB)) {
    idx_val_f <- folds_xgb[[f]]
    idx_tr_f  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_xgb_train)), idx_val_f)

    d_tr_f <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
      data  = X_xgb_train[idx_tr_f,  , drop = FALSE],
      label = y_xgb_train[idx_tr_f]
    )
    d_vl_f <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
      data  = X_xgb_train[idx_val_f, , drop = FALSE],
      label = y_xgb_train[idx_val_f]
    )

    m_fold <- tryCatch({
      xgboost::xgb.train(
        params        = params_i,
        data          = d_tr_f,
        nrounds       = NROUNDS_CV,
        evals         = list(val = d_vl_f),
        verbose       = 0L,
        print_every_n = 9999L
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  Fold %d/combo %d erreur : %s\n", f, i, e$message))
      NULL
    })

    if (!is.null(m_fold)) {
      # Récupération du meilleur logloss de validation depuis l'historique
      logloss_hist <- m_fold$evaluation_log$val_mlogloss
      fold_logloss[f] <- min(logloss_hist)
    } else {
      fold_logloss[f] <- NA_real_
    }

    rm(d_tr_f, d_vl_f, m_fold); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }

  cv_results_xgb[[i]] <- data.frame(
    iter          = i,
    mean_logloss  = mean(fold_logloss, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_logloss    = sd(fold_logloss,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid_folds = sum(!is.na(fold_logloss)),
    sampled_xgb[i, , drop = FALSE],
    row.names     = NULL
  )

  setTxtProgressBar(pb_xgb, i)
}
close(pb_xgb)

cv_df_xgb <- do.call(rbind, cv_results_xgb)
n_valid <- sum(!is.nan(cv_df_xgb$mean_logloss) & !is.na(cv_df_xgb$mean_logloss))
cat(sprintf("\n\n  Combinaisons avec score valide : %d / %d\n", n_valid, N_RANDOM_XGB))

if (n_valid == 0) {
  stop("XGBoost ne produit pas de scores valides.")
}

cv_df_xgb    <- cv_df_xgb[order(cv_df_xgb$mean_logloss, na.last = TRUE), ]
best_xgb_row <- cv_df_xgb[1, ]

cat(sprintf("  Meilleur mlogloss CV  : %.6f ± %.6f (sur %d folds valides)\n",
            best_xgb_row$mean_logloss, best_xgb_row$sd_logloss,
            best_xgb_row$n_valid_folds))
cat("  Meilleurs paramètres  :\n")
for (col in names(sampled_xgb)) {
  cat(sprintf("    %-22s = %s\n", col, as.character(best_xgb_row[[col]])))
}

# ── Entraînement final ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
params_best_xgb <- c(
  params_xgb_fixed,
  as.list(best_xgb_row[, names(sampled_xgb), drop = FALSE])
)

cat("\n  Entraînement final (early stopping sur X_val)...\n")
t0_xgb <- proc.time()

xgb_final <- xgboost::xgb.train(
  params                = params_best_xgb,
  data                  = dtrain_xgb,
  nrounds               = NROUNDS_FINAL,
  evals                 = list(train = dtrain_xgb, val = dval_xgb),
  early_stopping_rounds = 30L,
  verbose               = 0L,
  print_every_n         = 9999L
)

elapsed_xgb <- (proc.time() - t0_xgb)["elapsed"]
best_iter   <- xgb_final$best_iteration
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Entraîné en %.1f s | Meilleure itération : %d\n",
            elapsed_xgb, best_iter))

# ── Prédictions (détection automatique byrow) ────────────────────────────────
xgb_proba_raw <- predict(xgb_final, dval_xgb)
n_val_xgb     <- nrow(X_xgb_val)
n_cls_xgb     <- length(CLASSES_XGB)

stopifnot(length(xgb_proba_raw) == n_val_xgb * n_cls_xgb)

mat_T <- matrix(xgb_proba_raw, nrow = n_val_xgb, ncol = n_cls_xgb, byrow = TRUE)
mat_F <- matrix(xgb_proba_raw, nrow = n_val_xgb, ncol = n_cls_xgb, byrow = FALSE)

err_T <- max(abs(rowSums(mat_T) - 1))
err_F <- max(abs(rowSums(mat_F) - 1))
cat(sprintf("  Diagnostic byrow XGB : err(TRUE)=%.2e | err(FALSE)=%.2e\n", err_T, err_F))

if (err_T <= err_F) {
  xgb_proba_val <- mat_T
  cat("  → byrow = TRUE sélectionné automatiquement\n")
} else {
  xgb_proba_val <- mat_F
  cat("  → byrow = FALSE sélectionné automatiquement\n")
}

colnames(xgb_proba_val) <- CLASSES_XGB
if (!identical(colnames(xgb_proba_val), levels(y_val))) {
  xgb_proba_val <- xgb_proba_val[, levels(y_val), drop = FALSE]
}
stopifnot(identical(colnames(xgb_proba_val), levels(y_val)))
stopifnot(all(abs(rowSums(xgb_proba_val) - 1) < 1e-5))

xgb_pred_val <- factor(
  levels(y_val)[apply(xgb_proba_val, 1, which.max)],
  levels = levels(y_val)
)

# ── Métriques ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
xgb_metrics <- compute_metrics(y_val, xgb_pred_val, xgb_proba_val)

cat(sprintf("\n  ── PERFORMANCE XGBOOST (VAL SET) ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  MCC      : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$MCC))
cat(sprintf("  AUC ROC  : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$AUC_ROC))
cat(sprintf("  BalAcc   : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$BalAcc))
cat(sprintf("  Accuracy : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$Accuracy))
cat(sprintf("  F1 macro : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$F1_macro))
cat(sprintf("  Brier    : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$Brier))
cat(sprintf("  LogLoss  : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$LogLoss))
cat(sprintf("  ECE      : %.4f\n", xgb_metrics$ECE))

# ── Importance ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
xgb_imp <- xgboost::xgb.importance(
  model         = xgb_final,
  feature_names = colnames(X_xgb_train)
)
cat(sprintf("\n  Top 10 gènes importants (XGBoost) :\n"))
cat(sprintf("  %-6s %-25s %10s %10s\n", "Rang", "Gène", "Gain", "Cover"))
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", strrep("─", 55)))
for (j in seq_len(min(10L, nrow(xgb_imp)))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-6d %-25s %10.4f %10.4f\n",
              j, xgb_imp$Feature[j], xgb_imp$Gain[j], xgb_imp$Cover[j]))
}

# ── Stockage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
trained_models[["XGBoost"]] <- xgb_final
metrics_val[["XGBoost"]]    <- xgb_metrics
training_times[["XGBoost"]] <- elapsed_xgb
best_params[["XGBoost"]]    <- as.list(best_xgb_row[, names(sampled_xgb)])

xgboost::xgb.save(xgb_final, "outputs/models/xgboost_final.model")
saveRDS(list(trained_models = trained_models,
             metrics_val    = metrics_val,
             best_params    = best_params),
        "outputs/models/models_checkpoint.rds")

cat("\n  💾 outputs/models/xgboost_final.model\n")
cat("  💾 outputs/models/models_checkpoint.rds\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ XGBoost terminé\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```




## 7.4 LightGBM (API native)

```{r lightgbm-model}
cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  7.4 LIGHTGBM — RandomizedSearch (API native)\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

set.seed(SEED)

# ── DIAGNOSTIC : ordre des classes 0‑based ─────────────────────────────────────
CLASSES_LGB <- levels(y_train)
cat(sprintf("  Ordre classes LightGBM (0-based) :\n"))
for (i in seq_along(CLASSES_LGB)) {
  cat(sprintf("    %d → %s (n=%d)\n", i-1L,
              CLASSES_LGB[i], sum(y_train == CLASSES_LGB[i])))
}
stopifnot(setequal(CLASSES_LGB, CLASSES))

# ── Préparation données ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_train_int <- as.integer(y_train) - 1L
y_val_int   <- as.integer(y_val)   - 1L

stopifnot(min(y_train_int) == 0L)
stopifnot(max(y_train_int) == length(CLASSES_LGB) - 1L)

cat(sprintf("\n  Vérification mapping label → entier :\n"))
for (i in seq_along(CLASSES_LGB)) {
  n_train <- sum(y_train_int == (i-1L))
  n_val   <- sum(y_val_int   == (i-1L))
  cat(sprintf("    %d → %-6s : train=%d, val=%d\n",
              i-1L, CLASSES_LGB[i], n_train, n_val))
}

dtrain_lgb <- lightgbm::lgb.Dataset(
  data  = as.matrix(X_tr),
  label = y_train_int
)
dval_lgb <- lightgbm::lgb.Dataset(
  data      = as.matrix(X_vl),
  label     = y_val_int,
  reference = dtrain_lgb
)

cat(sprintf("\n  X_train : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_tr), ncol(X_tr)))
cat(sprintf("  X_val   : %d × %d\n", nrow(X_vl), ncol(X_vl)))

# ── Paramètres fixes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
params_fixed <- list(
  objective   = "multiclass",
  num_class   = length(CLASSES_LGB),
  metric      = "multi_logloss",
  boosting    = "gbdt",
  num_threads = max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L),
  verbose     = -1L,
  seed        = SEED
)

# ── Grille RandomizedSearch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_RANDOM_LGB <- 50L

lgb_full_grid <- expand.grid(
  learning_rate    = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2),
  num_leaves       = c(7, 15, 31, 63, 127, 255),
  max_depth        = c(3, 5, 7, 10, 15, -1),
  min_data_in_leaf = c(1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50),
  feature_fraction = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0),
  bagging_fraction = c(0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0),
  bagging_freq     = c(1, 5, 10),
  lambda_l1        = c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
  lambda_l2        = c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
  min_split_gain   = c(0, 0.1, 0.5, 1),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

n_total_lgb <- nrow(lgb_full_grid)
set.seed(SEED)
lgb_search_grid <- lgb_full_grid[sample(n_total_lgb, N_RANDOM_LGB), , drop = FALSE]

cat(sprintf("\n  Grille : %d / %d combinaisons échantillonnées\n",
            N_RANDOM_LGB, n_total_lgb))

# ── Fonction robuste pour extraire le meilleur logloss ────────────────────────
get_best_lgb_logloss <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA_real_)
  evals <- tryCatch(
    unlist(model$record_evals$val$multi_logloss$eval),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(evals) && length(evals) > 0) {
    return(min(evals, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}

# ── CV 5‑fold manuel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_FOLDS_LGB <- 5L
folds_lgb   <- caret::createFolds(y_train, k = N_FOLDS_LGB,
                                   list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
cv_results_lgb <- vector("list", N_RANDOM_LGB)

cat("  Recherche aléatoire en cours...\n")
pb_lgb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0L, max = N_RANDOM_LGB, style = 3)

for (i in seq_len(N_RANDOM_LGB)) {
  params_i     <- c(params_fixed, as.list(lgb_search_grid[i, , drop = FALSE]))
  fold_logloss <- numeric(N_FOLDS_LGB)

  for (f in seq_len(N_FOLDS_LGB)) {
    idx_val_f <- folds_lgb[[f]]
    idx_tr_f  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_tr)), idx_val_f)

    dtr_f <- lightgbm::lgb.Dataset(
      data  = as.matrix(X_tr[idx_tr_f, , drop = FALSE]),
      label = y_train_int[idx_tr_f]
    )
    dvl_f <- lightgbm::lgb.Dataset(
      data      = as.matrix(X_tr[idx_val_f, , drop = FALSE]),
      label     = y_train_int[idx_val_f],
      reference = dtr_f
    )

    m_fold <- tryCatch({
      lightgbm::lgb.train(
        params                = params_i,
        data                  = dtr_f,
        nrounds               = 300L,
        valids                = list(val = dvl_f),
        early_stopping_rounds = 15L,
        verbose               = -1L
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)

    fold_logloss[f] <- get_best_lgb_logloss(m_fold)
    rm(dtr_f, dvl_f, m_fold); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }

  cv_results_lgb[[i]] <- data.frame(
    iter         = i,
    mean_logloss = mean(fold_logloss, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_logloss   = sd(fold_logloss,   na.rm = TRUE),
    lgb_search_grid[i, , drop = FALSE],
    row.names    = NULL
  )

  setTxtProgressBar(pb_lgb, i)
}
close(pb_lgb)

cv_df_lgb    <- do.call(rbind, cv_results_lgb)
cv_df_lgb    <- cv_df_lgb[order(cv_df_lgb$mean_logloss, na.last = TRUE), ]
best_lgb_row <- cv_df_lgb[1, ]

cat(sprintf("\n\n  ✓ RandomizedSearch terminé\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Meilleur logloss (CV)  : %.6f ± %.6f\n",
            best_lgb_row$mean_logloss, best_lgb_row$sd_logloss))
cat("  Meilleurs paramètres   :\n")
for (col in names(lgb_search_grid)) {
  cat(sprintf("    %-20s = %s\n", col, as.character(best_lgb_row[[col]])))
}

# ── Entraînement final ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  Entraînement final avec early stopping...\n")

params_best_lgb <- c(
  params_fixed,
  as.list(best_lgb_row[, names(lgb_search_grid), drop = FALSE])
)

t0_lgb <- proc.time()

lgb_model <- lightgbm::lgb.train(
  params                = params_best_lgb,
  data                  = dtrain_lgb,
  nrounds               = 500L,
  valids                = list(val = dval_lgb),
  early_stopping_rounds = 20L,
  verbose               = -1L
)

elapsed_lgb <- (proc.time() - t0_lgb)["elapsed"]
best_logloss_final <- get_best_lgb_logloss(lgb_model)
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Entraîné en %.1f s\n", elapsed_lgb))
cat(sprintf("  Meilleure itération    : %d\n", lgb_model$best_iter))
cat(sprintf("  Logloss val (best)     : %.6f\n", best_logloss_final))

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PRÉDICTIONS (CORRIGÉES – DÉTECTION AUTOMATIQUE byrow)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
lgb_proba_raw <- predict(lgb_model, as.matrix(X_vl))

n_val_lgb <- nrow(X_vl)
n_cls_lgb <- length(CLASSES_LGB)

stopifnot(length(lgb_proba_raw) == n_val_lgb * n_cls_lgb)

# Détection automatique de l'orientation (byrow)
mat_T <- matrix(lgb_proba_raw, nrow = n_val_lgb, ncol = n_cls_lgb, byrow = TRUE)
mat_F <- matrix(lgb_proba_raw, nrow = n_val_lgb, ncol = n_cls_lgb, byrow = FALSE)

err_T <- max(abs(rowSums(mat_T) - 1))
err_F <- max(abs(rowSums(mat_F) - 1))
cat(sprintf("  Diagnostic byrow LGB : err(TRUE)=%.2e | err(FALSE)=%.2e\n", err_T, err_F))

if (err_T <= err_F) {
  lgb_proba_val <- mat_T
  cat("  → byrow = TRUE sélectionné automatiquement\n")
} else {
  lgb_proba_val <- mat_F
  cat("  → byrow = FALSE sélectionné automatiquement\n")
}

# Assigner les noms de colonnes dans l'ordre du modèle
colnames(lgb_proba_val) <- CLASSES_LGB

# Vérification d'alignement avec y_val
if (!identical(colnames(lgb_proba_val), levels(y_val))) {
  # Au cas où levels(y_val) serait différent (ne devrait pas arriver)
  lgb_proba_val <- lgb_proba_val[, levels(y_val), drop = FALSE]
}
stopifnot(identical(colnames(lgb_proba_val), levels(y_val)))
stopifnot(all(abs(rowSums(lgb_proba_val) - 1) < 1e-5))

# Prédiction de classe
lgb_pred_val <- factor(
  levels(y_val)[apply(lgb_proba_val, 1, which.max)],
  levels = levels(y_val)
)

# ── Métriques ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lgb_metrics <- compute_metrics(y_val, lgb_pred_val, lgb_proba_val)

cat(sprintf("\n  ── PERFORMANCE LIGHTGBM (VAL SET) ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  MCC      : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$MCC))
cat(sprintf("  AUC ROC  : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$AUC_ROC))
cat(sprintf("  BalAcc   : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$BalAcc))
cat(sprintf("  F1 macro : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$F1_macro))
cat(sprintf("  Brier    : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$Brier))
cat(sprintf("  BSS      : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$BSS))
cat(sprintf("  LogLoss  : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$LogLoss))
cat(sprintf("  ECE      : %.4f\n", lgb_metrics$ECE))

# ── Importance ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lgb_imp <- lightgbm::lgb.importance(lgb_model, percentage = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("\n  ── TOP 10 FEATURES (LIGHTGBM) ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  %-6s %-25s %10s\n", "Rang", "Gène", "Gain (%)"))
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", strrep("─", 45)))
feat_names_tr <- if (!is.null(colnames(X_tr))) colnames(X_tr) else
                  paste0("gene_", seq_len(ncol(X_tr)))
for (j in seq_len(min(10L, nrow(lgb_imp)))) {
  fn <- lgb_imp$Feature[j]
  if (grepl("^V[0-9]+$", fn)) {
    idx <- as.integer(sub("^V", "", fn))
    fn  <- if (idx <= length(feat_names_tr)) feat_names_tr[idx] else fn
  }
  cat(sprintf("  %-6d %-25s %9.2f%%\n", j, fn, lgb_imp$Gain[j]))
}

# ── Stockage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
trained_models[["LightGBM"]] <- lgb_model
metrics_val[["LightGBM"]]    <- lgb_metrics
training_times[["LightGBM"]] <- elapsed_lgb
best_params[["LightGBM"]]    <- as.list(best_lgb_row[, names(lgb_search_grid)])

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TABLEAU COMPARATIF FINAL (inchangé, mais peut rester ici)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ... (votre code de tableau comparatif, graphiques etc. reste identique)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TABLEAU COMPARATIF FINAL — 8 MODÈLES COMPLETS
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

MODELS_ORDER <- c("LogisticReg","SVM_Lin","SVM_RBF","KNN",
                  "RandomForest","MLP","XGBoost","LightGBM")

models_ok  <- intersect(MODELS_ORDER, names(metrics_val))
models_nok <- setdiff(MODELS_ORDER, names(metrics_val))

safe_val <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x)

metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models_ok, function(nm) {
  met <- metrics_val[[nm]]
  bp  <- best_params[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    Model    = nm,
    MCC      = safe_val(met$MCC),
    AUC_ROC  = safe_val(met$AUC_ROC),
    PR_AUC   = safe_val(met$PR_AUC),
    BalAcc   = safe_val(met$BalAcc),
    F1_macro = safe_val(met$F1_macro),
    Accuracy = safe_val(met$Accuracy),
    Brier    = safe_val(met$Brier),
    BSS      = safe_val(met$BSS),
    LogLoss  = safe_val(met$LogLoss),
    ECE      = safe_val(met$ECE),
    Gmean    = safe_val(met$Gmean),
    Temps_s  = safe_val(training_times[[nm]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Ajouter lignes NA pour les modèles absents
if (length(models_nok) > 0) {
  na_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models_nok, function(nm) {
    data.frame(Model=nm, MCC=NA_real_, AUC_ROC=NA_real_, PR_AUC=NA_real_,
               BalAcc=NA_real_, F1_macro=NA_real_, Accuracy=NA_real_,
               Brier=NA_real_, BSS=NA_real_, LogLoss=NA_real_,
               ECE=NA_real_, Gmean=NA_real_, Temps_s=NA_real_,
               stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))
  metrics_df <- rbind(metrics_df, na_rows)
}

metrics_df <- metrics_df[order(metrics_df$MCC, decreasing=TRUE, na.last=TRUE), ]
rownames(metrics_df) <- NULL

# ── Affichage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n")
cat("╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("  TABLEAU COMPARATIF FINAL — 8 MODÈLES PANCAN (VAL SET)\n")
cat("╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")

md <- metrics_df
for (col in setdiff(names(md), "Model"))
  md[[col]] <- round(md[[col]], 4)

cat("── MÉTRIQUES PRINCIPALES ──\n\n")
print(md[, c("Model","MCC","AUC_ROC","PR_AUC","BalAcc","F1_macro","Accuracy","Temps_s")],
      row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n── MÉTRIQUES DE CALIBRATION ──\n\n")
print(md[, c("Model","Brier","BSS","LogLoss","ECE","Gmean")],
      row.names = FALSE)

# Podium
valid_rows <- metrics_df[!is.na(metrics_df$MCC), ]
cat("\n")
cat("  ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat(sprintf("  ║  🥇 %-12s MCC=%.4f  AUC=%.4f     ║\n",
            valid_rows$Model[1], valid_rows$MCC[1], valid_rows$AUC_ROC[1]))
if (nrow(valid_rows) >= 2)
  cat(sprintf("  ║  🥈 %-12s MCC=%.4f  AUC=%.4f     ║\n",
              valid_rows$Model[2], valid_rows$MCC[2], valid_rows$AUC_ROC[2]))
if (nrow(valid_rows) >= 3)
  cat(sprintf("  ║  🥉 %-12s MCC=%.4f  AUC=%.4f     ║\n",
              valid_rows$Model[3], valid_rows$MCC[3], valid_rows$AUC_ROC[3]))
cat("  ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n")

if (length(models_nok) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  Modèles absents (réexécuter leur chunk) : %s\n",
              paste(models_nok, collapse = ", ")))

# ── Visualisation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggplot2)

plot_df <- metrics_df[!is.na(metrics_df$MCC), ]
plot_df$Model <- factor(plot_df$Model, levels = plot_df$Model[order(plot_df$MCC)])

model_colors <- c(
  "MLP"="E64B35","LogisticReg"="4DBBD5","KNN"="00A087",
  "RandomForest"="3C5488","SVM_RBF"="F39B7F","SVM_Lin"="8491B4",
  "XGBoost"="91D1C2","LightGBM"="DC0000"
)
pal <- setNames(paste0("#", model_colors), names(model_colors))
pal_used <- pal[levels(plot_df$Model)]
pal_used[is.na(pal_used)] <- "grey60"

p_mcc <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Model, y = MCC, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.90, color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.4f", MCC)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(min(0, min(plot_df$MCC, na.rm=TRUE) - 0.05), 1.10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_used, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title    = "Comparaison MCC — 8 modèles PANCAN",
    subtitle = sprintf("%d gènes biomarqueurs | n_val=%d | 5 types de cancer",
                       FINAL_PANEL_SIZE, nrow(X_vl)),
    x = NULL, y = "MCC (↑ meilleur)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_mcc)

# Heatmap
library(reshape2)
hm_df  <- plot_df[, c("Model","MCC","AUC_ROC","BalAcc","F1_macro","BSS","ECE","Gmean")]
hm_df$ECE <- 1 - hm_df$ECE   # inverser ECE
names(hm_df)[names(hm_df)=="ECE"] <- "1-ECE"

melt_hm <- melt(hm_df, id.vars="Model")
melt_hm$Model <- factor(melt_hm$Model,
                          levels = rev(levels(plot_df$Model)))

p_heat <- ggplot(melt_hm, aes(x=variable, y=Model, fill=value)) +
  geom_tile(color="white", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.3f", value)), size=3, fontface="bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="#D73027", mid="#FEE090", high="#1A9850",
                        midpoint=0.75, limits=c(0,1),
                        na.value="grey85", name="Score") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("MCC","AUC","BalAcc","F1","BSS","1-ECE","Gmean")) +
  labs(title    = "Heatmap comparative — 8 modèles × 7 métriques",
       subtitle = "PANCAN 5 types | Vert=meilleur | Rouge=moins bon",
       x=NULL, y=NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold"), panel.grid=element_blank())

print(p_heat)

# ── Sauvegarde ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
saveRDS(lgb_model,  "outputs/models/lgb_model.rds")
saveRDS(trained_models, "outputs/models/all_trained_models.rds")
saveRDS(metrics_val,    "outputs/models/metrics_val_list.rds")
saveRDS(trained_models[[valid_rows$Model[1]]], "outputs/models/best_model.rds")

write.csv(metrics_df, "outputs/metrics/metrics_val_8models.csv", row.names=FALSE)
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_MCC_8models.pdf",
       p_mcc,  width=9, height=5, dpi=300, device=cairo_pdf)
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_Heatmap_8models.pdf",
       p_heat, width=10, height=6, dpi=300, device=cairo_pdf)

cat("\n  💾 Fichiers sauvegardés :\n")
cat("     outputs/metrics/metrics_val_8models.csv\n")
cat("     outputs/figures/Fig_MCC_8models.pdf\n")
cat("     outputs/figures/Fig_Heatmap_8models.pdf\n")
cat("     outputs/models/best_model.rds\n")
cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ 7.4 + Tableau final terminés\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
