# Phase 8 — Évaluation Finale (Test Set)

::: callout-warning
**Règle absolue :** Le test set est utilisé **UNE SEULE FOIS**, après
sélection du meilleur modèle sur le val set. Toute ré-évaluation
constitue un data leakage implicite.
:::

## 8.1 Sélection du meilleur modèle et test final

```{r test-evaluation, fig.cap="Matrice de confusion du meilleur modèle sur le test set (20%). Les valeurs en gras montrent les pourcentages de recall par classe."}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7.5 TEST FINAL — Évaluation sur le jeu de test indépendant
#
# PROTOCOLE (rigoureux, publiable) :
#   1. Sélection du meilleur modèle basée sur MCC (VAL SET)
#   2. Évaluation UNIQUE sur le TEST SET (pas de ré-optimisation)
#   3. Métriques complètes + Intervalles de confiance bootstrap
#   4. Matrice de confusion + Courbes ROC
#   5. Analyse des erreurs par classe
#
# JUSTIFICATION DU CHOIX DE MCC :
#   MCC (Matthews Correlation Coefficient) est la métrique recommandée
#   pour les problèmes multiclasses avec déséquilibre modéré.
#   Contrairement à l'Accuracy, MCC utilise toutes les cellules de la
#   matrice de confusion et n'est pas biaisé par la prévalence.
#   Réf : Chicco & Jurman (2020) BMC Genomics
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  8.1 TEST FINAL — Évaluation sur jeu de test indépendant\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# ── 1. Sélection du meilleur modèle (VAL SET) ───────────────────────────────
# Vérifier que metrics_df existe et contient des données
if (!exists("metrics_df") || nrow(metrics_df) == 0) {
  stop("metrics_df introuvable. Exécuter d'abord l'entraînement des modèles.")
}

# Filtrer les modèles qui ont réussi (MCC non NA)
valid_models <- metrics_df[!is.na(metrics_df$MCC), ]

if (nrow(valid_models) == 0) {
  stop("Aucun modèle n'a convergé. Vérifier les données d'entraînement.")
}

# Meilleur modèle selon MCC sur VAL
best_idx   <- which.max(valid_models$MCC)
best_name  <- valid_models$Model[best_idx]
best_mcc_val <- valid_models$MCC[best_idx]

cat(sprintf("\n  ── SÉLECTION DU MEILLEUR MODÈLE ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Critère               : MCC sur VALIDATION SET\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Meilleur modèle       : %s\n", best_name))
cat(sprintf("  MCC (VAL)             : %.4f\n", best_mcc_val))
cat(sprintf("  AUC (VAL)             : %.4f\n", valid_models$AUC_ROC[best_idx]))
cat(sprintf("  Temps entraînement    : %.1f s\n", valid_models$Temps_s[best_idx]))

# Afficher les meilleurs hyperparamètres
if (exists("best_params") && !is.null(best_params[[best_name]])) {
  cat(sprintf("  Meilleurs paramètres  :\n"))
  bp <- best_params[[best_name]]
  if (is.data.frame(bp) || is.list(bp)) {
    for (nm in names(bp)) {
      cat(sprintf("    %-20s = %s\n", nm, as.character(bp[[nm]])))
    }
  }
}

# ── 2. Récupération du modèle ───────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("trained_models") || is.null(trained_models[[best_name]])) {
  # Tentative de chargement
  if (file.exists("outputs/models/best_model.rds")) {
    best_model <- readRDS("outputs/models/best_model.rds")
    cat("  ✓ Modèle chargé depuis outputs/models/best_model.rds\n")
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("Modèle '%s' introuvable.", best_name))
  }
} else {
  best_model <- trained_models[[best_name]]
}

# ── 3. Prédictions sur TEST SET ─────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── PRÉDICTIONS SUR TEST SET (%d échantillons) ──\n", nrow(X_te)))

# Gestion spécifique LightGBM (API différente)
if (best_name == "LightGBM") {
  # LightGBM : reshape=TRUE pour obtenir une matrice n×K
  y_proba_test <- predict(best_model, as.matrix(X_te), reshape = TRUE)
  colnames(y_proba_test) <- CLASSES
  
  # Vérifier que les probabilités somment à 1
  row_sums <- rowSums(y_proba_test)
  if (any(abs(row_sums - 1) > 0.01)) {
    warning("Les probabilités LightGBM ne somment pas à 1. Normalisation appliquée.")
    y_proba_test <- y_proba_test / row_sums
  }
  
  y_pred_test <- factor(
    CLASSES[apply(y_proba_test, 1, which.max)],
    levels = CLASSES
  )
  
} else {
  # Modèles caret : predict() standard
  y_pred_test <- predict(best_model, X_te)
  y_proba_test <- predict(best_model, X_te, type = "prob")
  
  # S'assurer que les colonnes sont dans l'ordre de CLASSES
  y_proba_test <- as.matrix(y_proba_test[, CLASSES, drop = FALSE])
}

# ── Vérifications ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
stopifnot(length(y_pred_test) == length(y_test))
stopifnot(nrow(y_proba_test) == length(y_test))
stopifnot(all(levels(y_pred_test) == CLASSES))
stopifnot(all(colnames(y_proba_test) == CLASSES))

cat(sprintf("  ✓ Prédictions générées : %d échantillons × %d classes\n", 
            length(y_pred_test), ncol(y_proba_test)))

# ── 4. Calcul des métriques de test ─────────────────────────────────────────
test_metrics <- compute_metrics(y_test, y_pred_test, y_proba_test)

cat(sprintf("\n  ── MÉTRIQUES DE TEST ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %s\n", "Métrique", "Valeur"))
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", paste(rep("─", 45), collapse = "")))

# Métriques de discrimination
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f  ← recommandé (Chicco & Jurman, 2020)\n", 
            "MCC", test_metrics$MCC))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f\n", "Accuracy", test_metrics$Accuracy))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f  ← moyenne des recalls\n", 
            "Balanced Accuracy", test_metrics$BalAcc))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f\n", "F1 macro", test_metrics$F1_macro))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f\n", "Cohen's Kappa", test_metrics$Kappa))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f  ← moyenne géométrique\n", "G-mean", test_metrics$Gmean))

# Métriques probabilistes
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f  ← macro OvR\n", "AUC-ROC", test_metrics$AUC_ROC))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f\n", "PR-AUC", test_metrics$PR_AUC))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f\n", "LogLoss", test_metrics$LogLoss))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f\n", "Brier Score", test_metrics$Brier))
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f  ← vs modèle nul\n", "Brier Skill Score", test_metrics$BSS))

# Calibration
cat(sprintf("  %-20s %.4f  ← < 0.05 = bien calibré\n", "ECE", test_metrics$ECE))

# ── 5. Intervalles de confiance par bootstrap ───────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── INTERVALLES DE CONFIANCE (Bootstrap, 2000 itérations) ──\n"))

set.seed(SEED)
n_boot <- 2000
n_test <- length(y_test)

boot_mcc <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_auc <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_bss <- numeric(n_boot)

pb_boot <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_boot, style = 3)

for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  idx <- sample(n_test, n_test, replace = TRUE)
  
  # MCC bootstrap
  boot_mcc[b] <- tryCatch(
    yardstick::mcc_vec(truth = y_test[idx], estimate = y_pred_test[idx]),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  
  # AUC bootstrap
  boot_auc[b] <- tryCatch({
    aucs <- vapply(seq_along(CLASSES), function(k) {
      y_bin_k <- as.integer(y_test[idx] == CLASSES[k])
      # Vérifier qu'il y a au moins 2 classes présentes
      if (length(unique(y_bin_k)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y_bin_k, y_proba_test[idx, k], 
                         quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))
    }, numeric(1))
    mean(aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  # BSS bootstrap
  boot_bss[b] <- tryCatch({
    y_bin_boot <- model.matrix(~ y_test[idx] - 1)
    bs_boot <- mean(rowSums((y_proba_test[idx, ] - y_bin_boot)^2))
    prev_boot <- colMeans(y_bin_boot)
    bs_null_boot <- sum(prev_boot * (1 - prev_boot))
    if (bs_null_boot > 0) 1 - bs_boot / bs_null_boot else 0
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb_boot, b)
}
close(pb_boot)

# Calcul des IC
mcc_ci <- quantile(boot_mcc, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
auc_ci <- quantile(boot_auc, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
bss_ci <- quantile(boot_bss, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("  MCC : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]\n", 
            test_metrics$MCC, mcc_ci[1], mcc_ci[2]))
cat(sprintf("  AUC : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]\n", 
            test_metrics$AUC_ROC, auc_ci[1], auc_ci[2]))
cat(sprintf("  BSS : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]\n", 
            test_metrics$BSS, bss_ci[1], bss_ci[2]))

# ── 6. Matrice de confusion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── MATRICE DE CONFUSION ──\n\n"))

# Matrice en effectifs
cm_mat <- table(Vrai = y_test, Prédit = y_pred_test)
print(cm_mat)

# Matrice en pourcentages (par ligne = recall)
cm_pct <- prop.table(cm_mat, margin = 1) * 100

cat(sprintf("\n  Rappels (Recall) par classe :\n"))
for (cl in CLASSES) {
  cat(sprintf("    %-5s : %.1f%%\n", cl, cm_pct[cl, cl]))
}

# ── 7. Visualisation : Matrice de confusion ─────────────────────────────────
# Préparation des données pour ggplot
cm_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cm_mat))
names(cm_df) <- c("Vrai", "Prédit", "Effectif")

cm_pct_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cm_pct))
names(cm_pct_df) <- c("Vrai", "Prédit", "Pourcentage")

cm_plot_df <- merge(cm_df, cm_pct_df, by = c("Vrai", "Prédit"))

p_cm <- ggplot(cm_plot_df, aes(x = Prédit, y = Vrai, fill = Pourcentage)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", Effectif, Pourcentage),
        color = Pourcentage > 50),
    size = 3.8, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low  = "#F5F5F5",
    high = "#2E75B6",
    name = "Rappel (%)",
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "grey20"),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Matrice de Confusion — %s (Test Set)", best_name),
    subtitle = sprintf("MCC = %.4f [%.4f, %.4f] | AUC = %.4f | %d échantillons",
                       test_metrics$MCC, mcc_ci[1], mcc_ci[2],
                       test_metrics$AUC_ROC, n_test),
    x        = "Classe prédite",
    y        = "Classe réelle"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_cm)

# ── 8. Courbes ROC par classe ───────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\n  ── COURBES ROC (One-vs-Rest) ──\n"))

roc_data <- data.frame()
auc_per_class <- numeric(length(CLASSES))
names(auc_per_class) <- CLASSES

for (ci in seq_along(CLASSES)) {
  cl <- CLASSES[ci]
  
  y_bin <- as.integer(y_test == cl)
  
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(y_bin, y_proba_test[, cl], quiet = TRUE)
  auc_per_class[cl] <- pROC::auc(roc_obj)
  
  roc_data <- rbind(roc_data, data.frame(
    FPR    = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR    = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Classe = paste0(cl, " (AUC = ", round(auc_per_class[cl], 3), ")")
  ))
  
  cat(sprintf("    %-5s : AUC = %.4f\n", cl, auc_per_class[cl]))
}

cat(sprintf("    MACRO : AUC = %.4f\n", test_metrics$AUC_ROC))

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Classe)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", 
              color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#3C5488", "#E64B35", "#27AE60", "#F39B7F", "#8E44AD"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Courbes ROC — %s (Test Set)", best_name),
    subtitle = sprintf("AUC macro = %.4f | %d gènes biomarqueurs",
                       test_metrics$AUC_ROC, FINAL_PANEL_SIZE),
    x        = "Taux de Faux Positifs (1 - Spécificité)",
    y        = "Taux de Vrais Positifs (Sensibilité)"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_roc)

# ── 9. Rapport final ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n")
cat("  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("  ║  RÉSULTAT FINAL — TEST SET (données non vues)                ║\n")
cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")
cat(sprintf("  ║  Modèle              : %-36s ║\n", best_name))
cat(sprintf("  ║  Biomarqueurs        : %-36d ║\n", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE))
cat(sprintf("  ║  Échantillons test   : %-36d ║\n", n_test))
cat(sprintf("  ║  MCC                 : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]       ║\n", 
            test_metrics$MCC, mcc_ci[1], mcc_ci[2]))
cat(sprintf("  ║  AUC macro           : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]       ║\n", 
            test_metrics$AUC_ROC, auc_ci[1], auc_ci[2]))
cat(sprintf("  ║  Balanced Accuracy   : %.4f                     ║\n", 
            test_metrics$BalAcc))
cat(sprintf("  ║  Brier Skill Score   : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]       ║\n", 
            test_metrics$BSS, bss_ci[1], bss_ci[2]))
cat(sprintf("  ║  ECE (calibration)   : %.4f                     ║\n", 
            test_metrics$ECE))
cat("  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n")

# ── 10. Sauvegarde ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sauvegarder les résultats de test
test_results <- list(
  model_name    = best_name,
  metrics       = test_metrics,
  ci_mcc        = mcc_ci,
  ci_auc        = auc_ci,
  ci_bss        = bss_ci,
  auc_per_class = auc_per_class,
  confusion_matrix = cm_mat,
  predictions   = data.frame(
    true  = y_test,
    pred  = y_pred_test,
    proba = y_proba_test
  )
)

saveRDS(test_results, "outputs/metrics/test_final_results.rds")

# Sauvegarder les figures
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_ConfusionMatrix_Test.pdf",
       p_cm, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)

ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_ROC_Test.pdf",
       p_roc, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)

# Sauvegarder les prédictions pour analyses ultérieures
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    Echantillon = seq_len(n_test),
    Classe_reelle = y_test,
    Classe_predite = y_pred_test,
    y_proba_test,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  "outputs/metrics/test_predictions.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(sprintf("\n  💾 Fichiers sauvegardés :\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/test_final_results.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/test_predictions.csv\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/figures/Fig_ConfusionMatrix_Test.pdf\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/figures/Fig_ROC_Test.pdf\n"))

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ 8.1 Terminé — Évaluation finale sur test set\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

## 8.2 Courbes ROC et PR

```{r roc-pr-curves, fig.cap="Courbes ROC (gauche) et PR (droite) par classe (one-vs-rest). L'AUC > 0.99 pour toutes les classes reflète la forte séparabilité transcriptomique des 5 cancers."}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7.6 COURBES ROC ET PRECISION-RAPPEL — Test Set
#
# OBJECTIF : Visualiser la performance de classification par classe
#
# ROC (Receiver Operating Characteristic) :
#   - TPR = TP / (TP + FN) vs FPR = FP / (FP + TN)
#   - Indique la capacité à discriminer chaque classe
#   - AUC = 1 → discrimination parfaite, AUC = 0.5 → aléatoire
#
# PR (Precision-Recall) :
#   - Precision = TP / (TP + FP) vs Recall = TP / (TP + FN)
#   - Plus informatif que ROC quand les classes sont déséquilibrées
#   - Baseline = prévalence de la classe (ligne horizontale)
#
# RÉFÉRENCES :
#   Davis & Goadrich (2006) ICML — Relation ROC/PR
#   Saito & Rehmsmeier (2015) Bioinformatics — PR curves
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  8.2 COURBES ROC ET PRECISION-RAPPEL\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# ── 1. Vérification des données nécessaires ─────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("y_proba_test") || !exists("y_test")) {
  stop("y_proba_test et y_test sont requis. Exécuter d'abord l'évaluation test.")
}

# S'assurer que y_test est un facteur
if (!is.factor(y_test)) {
  y_test <- factor(y_test, levels = CLASSES)
}

# ── 2. Définition des couleurs (si non existantes) ──────────────────────────
if (!exists("TUMOR_COLORS")) {
  TUMOR_COLORS <- c(
    "BRCA" = "#3C5488",
    "KIRC" = "#E64B35",
    "COAD" = "#27AE60",
    "LUAD" = "#F39B7F",
    "PRAD" = "#8E44AD"
  )
}

# ── 3. Courbes ROC par classe ───────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("  Calcul des courbes ROC (One-vs-Rest)...\n")

roc_data <- data.frame()
auc_roc_values <- numeric(length(CLASSES))
names(auc_roc_values) <- CLASSES

for (k in seq_along(CLASSES)) {
  cl <- CLASSES[k]
  
  # Binarisation one-vs-rest
  y_bin <- as.integer(y_test == cl)
  prob_k <- y_proba_test[, cl]
  
  # Calcul ROC via pROC
  roc_k <- pROC::roc(y_bin, prob_k, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")
  auc_roc_values[cl] <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_k))
  
  # Extraire les coordonnées
  roc_data <- rbind(roc_data, data.frame(
    FPR       = 1 - roc_k$specificities,
    TPR       = roc_k$sensitivities,
    Classe    = cl,
    AUC_label = sprintf("%s (AUC = %.4f)", cl, auc_roc_values[cl]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
  
  cat(sprintf("    %-5s : AUC = %.4f\n", cl, auc_roc_values[cl]))
}

cat(sprintf("    MACRO : AUC = %.4f\n", mean(auc_roc_values)))

# ── 4. Courbes Precision-Recall par classe ───────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  Calcul des courbes Precision-Recall...\n")

pr_data <- data.frame()
auc_pr_values <- numeric(length(CLASSES))
names(auc_pr_values) <- CLASSES
baseline_values <- numeric(length(CLASSES))
names(baseline_values) <- CLASSES

for (k in seq_along(CLASSES)) {
  cl <- CLASSES[k]
  
  y_bin <- as.integer(y_test == cl)
  prob_k <- y_proba_test[, cl]
  
  # Baseline = prévalence de la classe positive
  prevalence <- mean(y_bin)
  baseline_values[cl] <- prevalence
  
  # Calcul PR via PRROC
  pr_k <- tryCatch({
    PRROC::pr.curve(
      scores.class0 = prob_k[y_bin == 1],
      scores.class1 = prob_k[y_bin == 0],
      curve = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("PRROC erreur pour %s : %s", cl, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(pr_k)) {
    auc_pr_values[cl] <- pr_k$auc.integral
    
    # Extraire les coordonnées de la courbe
    pr_data <- rbind(pr_data, data.frame(
      Recall    = pr_k$curve[, 1],
      Precision = pr_k$curve[, 2],
      Classe    = cl,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    cat(sprintf("    %-5s : PR-AUC = %.4f (baseline = %.4f)\n", 
                cl, auc_pr_values[cl], prevalence))
  } else {
    auc_pr_values[cl] <- NA
    cat(sprintf("    %-5s : PR-AUC = ERREUR\n", cl))
  }
}

cat(sprintf("    MACRO : PR-AUC = %.4f\n", mean(auc_pr_values, na.rm = TRUE)))

# ── 5. Visualisation : Courbes ROC ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Créer des labels uniques avec AUC pour la légende
auc_labels <- unique(roc_data[, c("Classe", "AUC_label")])

# Palette de couleurs cohérente
roc_colors <- TUMOR_COLORS[auc_labels$Classe]
names(roc_colors) <- auc_labels$AUC_label

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = AUC_label)) +
  # Diagonale (classifieur aléatoire)
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  # Courbes ROC
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Échelle de couleurs
  scale_color_manual(values = roc_colors, name = "Classe tumorale (AUC)") +
  # Annotation AUC macro
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 0.15,
           label = sprintf("AUC macro = %.4f", mean(auc_roc_values)),
           size = 3.5, color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
  # Axes et thème
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title    = "(a) Courbes ROC par classe (One-vs-Rest)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Test Set (%d échantillons) | %d biomarqueurs",
                       length(y_test), FINAL_PANEL_SIZE),
    x        = "Taux de Faux Positifs (1 - Spécificité)",
    y        = "Taux de Vrais Positifs (Sensibilité)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", 
                                     linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_roc)

# ── 6. Visualisation : Courbes Precision-Recall ──────────────────────────────
# Calculer les positions pour les lignes de baseline
pr_baseline <- data.frame(
  Classe    = names(baseline_values),
  Baseline  = baseline_values,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

p_pr <- ggplot(pr_data, aes(x = Recall, y = Precision, color = Classe)) +
  # Courbes PR
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Lignes de baseline (prévalence)
  geom_hline(data = pr_baseline, 
             aes(yintercept = Baseline, color = Classe),
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Échelle de couleurs
  scale_color_manual(values = TUMOR_COLORS, name = "Classe tumorale") +
  # Annotation PR-AUC macro
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 0.15,
           label = sprintf("PR-AUC macro = %.4f", 
                           mean(auc_pr_values, na.rm = TRUE)),
           size = 3.5, color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
  # Axes et thème
  labs(
    title    = "(b) Courbes Precision-Recall par classe",
    subtitle = "Lignes pointillées = baseline (prévalence de la classe)",
    x        = "Recall (Sensibilité)",
    y        = "Precision (Valeur Prédictive Positive)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", 
                                     linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_pr)

# ── 7. Assemblage final ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig_roc_pr <- (p_roc | p_pr) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = sprintf("Courbes ROC et Precision-Recall — %s (Test Set)", 
                       best_name),
    subtitle = sprintf("%d biomarqueurs | %d échantillons test",
                       FINAL_PANEL_SIZE, length(y_test)),
    tag_levels = "a",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40")
    )
  )

print(fig_roc_pr)

# ── 8. Tableau récapitulatif AUC ────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  ── RÉCAPITULATIF AUC PAR CLASSE ──\n")
auc_summary <- data.frame(
  Classe       = CLASSES,
  AUC_ROC      = auc_roc_values,
  PR_AUC       = auc_pr_values,
  Baseline     = baseline_values,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
auc_summary$AUC_ROC <- round(auc_summary$AUC_ROC, 4)
auc_summary$PR_AUC  <- round(auc_summary$PR_AUC, 4)
auc_summary$Baseline <- round(auc_summary$Baseline, 4)

print(auc_summary, row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\n  AUC-ROC macro  : %.4f\n", mean(auc_roc_values)))
cat(sprintf("  PR-AUC macro   : %.4f\n", mean(auc_pr_values, na.rm = TRUE)))

# ── 9. Sauvegarde ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sauvegarde des données
saveRDS(list(
  roc_data      = roc_data,
  pr_data       = pr_data,
  auc_roc       = auc_roc_values,
  auc_pr        = auc_pr_values,
  baseline      = baseline_values,
  auc_summary   = auc_summary
), "outputs/metrics/roc_pr_data.rds")

# Sauvegarde des figures
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_ROC_Curves.pdf",
       p_roc, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)

ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_PR_Curves.pdf",
       p_pr, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)

ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_ROC_PR_Combined.pdf",
       fig_roc_pr, width = 13, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)

# Sauvegarde du tableau
write.csv(auc_summary, "outputs/metrics/auc_by_class.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\n  💾 Fichiers sauvegardés :\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/roc_pr_data.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/auc_by_class.csv\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/figures/Fig_ROC_Curves.pdf\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/figures/Fig_PR_Curves.pdf\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/figures/Fig_ROC_PR_Combined.pdf\n"))

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ 8.2 Terminé — Courbes ROC et PR\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

---

# Phase 9 — Nested Cross-Validation

```{r nested-cv}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PHASE 8 — NESTED CROSS-VALIDATION (Estimation non-biaisée)
#
# JUSTIFICATION (pourquoi c'est indispensable pour une publication) :
#
#   RandomizedSearchCV standard = estimation OPTIMISTE de la performance.
#   Pourquoi ? Les mêmes données servent au tuning ET à l'évaluation.
#   → Biais de sélection : le modèle est optimisé pour ce split particulier.
#
#   Nested CV = estimation HONNÊTE et SANS BIAIS (Cawley & Talbot, 2010 JMLR)
#   - Outer loop (5-fold) : évalue la performance de généralisation
#   - Inner loop (5-fold) : optimise les hyperparamètres
#   → Les données d'évaluation NE SONT JAMAIS vues pendant le tuning.
#
#   Test de permutation additionnel (Ojala & Garriga, 2010 JMLR) :
#   - H₀ : "Le modèle n'apprend rien (MCC = 0)"
#   - On permute les labels et on recalcule la performance
#   - Si la performance observée > 95e percentile de H₀ → significatif
#
# RÉFÉRENCES :
#   Cawley & Talbot (2010) "On Over-fitting in Model Selection" — JMLR
#   Varma & Simon (2006) "Bias in Error Estimation" — BMC Bioinformatics
#   Ojala & Garriga (2010) "Permutation Tests for Classification" — JMLR
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 9 — NESTED CROSS-VALIDATION\n")
cat("  Estimation non-biaisée + Test de permutation\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

set.seed(SEED)

# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_OUTER <- 5   # Folds externes (estimation)
N_INNER <- 5   # Folds internes (tuning)
N_PERM  <- 500 # Permutations pour le test de significativité

# ── Sélection des modèles à évaluer en Nested CV ────────────────────────────
# On prend les 3 meilleurs modèles (selon MCC sur VAL)
if (!exists("metrics_df") || nrow(metrics_df) == 0) {
  stop("metrics_df introuvable. Exécuter d'abord l'entraînement des modèles.")
}

# Top 3 modèles (hors LightGBM si trop lent, mais inclus si dans le top)
top_models <- metrics_df[!is.na(metrics_df$MCC), ]
top_models <- top_models[order(top_models$MCC, decreasing = TRUE), ]
top_3_names <- head(top_models$Model, 3)

cat(sprintf("\n  Modèles évalués en Nested CV (top-3 VAL) :\n"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(head(top_models, 3)))) {
  cat(sprintf("    %d. %-20s (MCC VAL = %.4f)\n", 
              i, top_models$Model[i], top_models$MCC[i]))
}

# ── Création des folds externes (stratifiés) ────────────────────────────────
outer_folds <- caret::createFolds(y_train, k = N_OUTER, list = TRUE, 
                                   returnTrain = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("\n  Outer loop : %d folds stratifiés\n", N_OUTER))
cat(sprintf("  Inner loop : %d folds pour le tuning\n", N_INNER))

# ── Contrôle pour la boucle interne ─────────────────────────────────────────
inner_ctrl <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "cv",
  number          = N_INNER,
  classProbs      = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = caret::multiClassSummary,
  verboseIter     = FALSE,
  allowParallel   = TRUE
)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FONCTION : Nested CV pour un modèle donné
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

run_nested_cv <- function(model_name, method, tune_grid, extra_args = list()) {
  
  cat(sprintf("\n  ── [%s] Nested CV %d×%d ──\n", 
              model_name, N_OUTER, N_INNER))
  
  # Stockage des résultats par fold
  fold_results <- data.frame(
    fold       = seq_len(N_OUTER),
    accuracy   = NA_real_,
    bal_acc    = NA_real_,
    mcc        = NA_real_,
    auc_roc    = NA_real_,
    f1_macro   = NA_real_,
    n_train    = NA_integer_,
    n_val      = NA_integer_,
    best_params = character(N_OUTER),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  pb_folds <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = N_OUTER, style = 3)
  
  for (fi in seq_len(N_OUTER)) {
    
    # Split outer : train vs validation
    train_idx <- outer_folds[[fi]]
    val_idx   <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_tr)), train_idx)
    
    X_train_outer <- X_tr[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    y_train_outer <- y_train[train_idx]
    X_val_outer   <- X_tr[val_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    y_val_outer   <- y_train[val_idx]
    
    # Stocker les tailles
    fold_results$n_train[fi] <- length(train_idx)
    fold_results$n_val[fi]   <- length(val_idx)
    
    # Inner loop : tuning des hyperparamètres sur X_train_outer UNIQUEMENT
    train_args <- c(
      list(
        x         = X_train_outer,
        y         = y_train_outer,
        method    = method,
        trControl = inner_ctrl,
        tuneGrid  = tune_grid,
        metric    = "AUC"
      ),
      extra_args
    )
    
    m_inner <- tryCatch({
      set.seed(SEED + fi)
      do.call(caret::train, train_args)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("\n  ✗ Fold %d : ERREUR — %s\n", fi, e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (is.null(m_inner)) next
    
    # Sauvegarder les meilleurs paramètres
    fold_results$best_params[fi] <- paste(
      names(m_inner$bestTune), "=", as.character(m_inner$bestTune), 
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    # Prédictions sur le fold outer (données JAMAIS vues pendant le tuning)
    y_pred_outer <- predict(m_inner, X_val_outer)
    y_prob_outer <- predict(m_inner, X_val_outer, type = "prob")
    y_prob_outer <- as.matrix(y_prob_outer[, CLASSES, drop = FALSE])
    
    # Métriques sur ce fold
    fold_results$accuracy[fi] <- mean(y_pred_outer == y_val_outer)
    fold_results$mcc[fi]      <- yardstick::mcc_vec(truth = y_val_outer, 
                                                      estimate = y_pred_outer)
    fold_results$bal_acc[fi]  <- yardstick::bal_accuracy_vec(
      truth = y_val_outer, estimate = y_pred_outer)
    fold_results$f1_macro[fi] <- yardstick::f_meas_vec(
      truth = y_val_outer, estimate = y_pred_outer, estimator = "macro")
    
    # AUC macro sur ce fold
    fold_results$auc_roc[fi] <- tryCatch({
      aucs <- vapply(seq_along(CLASSES), function(k) {
        y_bin <- as.integer(y_val_outer == CLASSES[k])
        pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y_bin, y_prob_outer[, k], 
                           quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))
      }, numeric(1))
      mean(aucs)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
    setTxtProgressBar(pb_folds, fi)
  }
  close(pb_folds)
  
  # Résumé
  cat(sprintf("\n  ✓ %s — Résumé Nested CV :\n", model_name))
  cat(sprintf("    Accuracy  : %.4f ± %.4f\n", 
              mean(fold_results$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(fold_results$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    MCC       : %.4f ± %.4f\n", 
              mean(fold_results$mcc, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(fold_results$mcc, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    BalAcc    : %.4f ± %.4f\n", 
              mean(fold_results$bal_acc, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(fold_results$bal_acc, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    AUC macro : %.4f ± %.4f\n", 
              mean(fold_results$auc_roc, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(fold_results$auc_roc, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  return(fold_results)
}

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXÉCUTION NESTED CV POUR CHAQUE MODÈLE DU TOP-3
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

nested_results <- list()

# Modèle 1 : Logistic Regression ElasticNet
if ("LogisticReg" %in% top_3_names) {
  glmnet_grid <- expand.grid(
    alpha  = c(0, 0.3, 0.7, 1.0),
    lambda = 10^seq(-4, 0, length.out = 15)
  )
  nested_results[["LogisticReg"]] <- run_nested_cv(
    "LogisticReg", "glmnet", glmnet_grid,
    extra_args = list(family = "multinomial", maxit = 1000)
  )
}

# Modèle 2 : Random Forest
if ("RandomForest" %in% top_3_names) {
  rf_mtry <- unique(c(
    floor(sqrt(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)),
    floor(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE / 3),
    floor(FINAL_PANEL_SIZE / 2),
    min(50, FINAL_PANEL_SIZE)
  ))
  rf_mtry <- rf_mtry[rf_mtry >= 2]
  
  rf_grid <- expand.grid(
    mtry           = rf_mtry,
    splitrule      = c("gini", "extratrees"),
    min.node.size  = c(1, 3, 5)
  )
  nested_results[["RandomForest"]] <- run_nested_cv(
    "RandomForest", "ranger", rf_grid,
    extra_args = list(num.trees = 500, importance = "impurity", verbose = FALSE)
  )
}

# Modèle 3 : XGBoost (ou autre selon le top-3)
if ("XGBoost" %in% top_3_names) {
  xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
    nrounds          = c(100, 200),
    max_depth        = c(3, 6),
    eta              = c(0.05, 0.1),
    gamma            = 0,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    min_child_weight = 1,
    subsample        = c(0.7, 0.9)
  )
  nested_results[["XGBoost"]] <- run_nested_cv(
    "XGBoost", "xgbTree", xgb_grid,
    extra_args = list(verbosity = 0)
  )
}

# Modèle SVM RBF (si dans le top-3)
if ("SVM_RBF" %in% top_3_names) {
  svm_grid <- expand.grid(
    C     = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100),
    sigma = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1)
  )
  nested_results[["SVM_RBF"]] <- run_nested_cv(
    "SVM_RBF", "svmRadial", svm_grid
  )
}

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TEST DE PERMUTATION (Validation statistique)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  TEST DE PERMUTATION — H₀ : MCC = 0 (modèle aléatoire)\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# Utiliser le meilleur modèle selon le Nested CV
best_nested_name <- names(which.max(sapply(nested_results, function(x) {
  mean(x$mcc, na.rm = TRUE)
})))

cat(sprintf("\n  Modèle testé : %s\n", best_nested_name))
cat(sprintf("  Permutations : %d\n", N_PERM))
cat(sprintf("  H₀ : Le modèle n'apprend rien (MCC = 0)\n"))

# Re-entraîner le meilleur modèle sur TOUT X_train pour le test
# (le nested CV a déjà confirmé la stabilité)
perm_mcc <- numeric(N_PERM)

cat("\n  Exécution des permutations...\n")
pb_perm <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = N_PERM, style = 3)

for (p in seq_len(N_PERM)) {
  # Permuter les labels
  y_perm <- sample(y_train)
  
  # Split train/val pour cette permutation (un seul fold, comme nested CV)
  fold_idx <- sample(seq_len(N_OUTER), 1)
  train_idx <- outer_folds[[fold_idx]]
  val_idx   <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_tr)), train_idx)
  
  # Inner CV sur données permutées
  m_perm <- tryCatch({
    set.seed(SEED + p)
    caret::train(
      x         = X_tr[train_idx, , drop = FALSE],
      y         = y_perm[train_idx],
      method    = if (best_nested_name == "LogisticReg") "glmnet" else
                  if (best_nested_name == "RandomForest") "ranger" else
                  if (best_nested_name == "XGBoost") "xgbTree" else "svmRadial",
      trControl = inner_ctrl,
      tuneGrid  = if (best_nested_name == "LogisticReg") {
        expand.grid(alpha = c(0, 0.5, 1), lambda = 10^seq(-3, 0, length.out = 8))
      } else if (best_nested_name == "RandomForest") {
        expand.grid(mtry = c(5, 20, 50), splitrule = "gini", min.node.size = c(1, 5))
      } else if (best_nested_name == "XGBoost") {
        expand.grid(nrounds = c(100, 200), max_depth = c(3, 6), eta = c(0.05, 0.1),
                    gamma = 0, colsample_bytree = 0.8, min_child_weight = 1,
                    subsample = 0.8)
      } else {
        expand.grid(C = c(1, 10), sigma = c(0.01, 0.1))
      },
      metric = "AUC"
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(m_perm)) {
    y_pred_perm <- predict(m_perm, X_tr[val_idx, , drop = FALSE])
    perm_mcc[p] <- yardstick::mcc_vec(truth = y_perm[val_idx], 
                                       estimate = y_pred_perm)
  }
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb_perm, p)
}
close(pb_perm)

# ── Résultats du test de permutation ────────────────────────────────────────
perm_mcc <- perm_mcc[!is.na(perm_mcc)]

# MCC observé (moyenne du nested CV)
observed_mcc <- mean(nested_results[[best_nested_name]]$mcc, na.rm = TRUE)

# p-value empirique
p_value_perm <- mean(perm_mcc >= observed_mcc)

# Percentile 95 de H₀
perm_threshold <- quantile(perm_mcc, 0.95)

cat(sprintf("\n\n  ── RÉSULTATS DU TEST DE PERMUTATION ──\n"))
cat(sprintf("  MCC observé (Nested CV)    : %.4f\n", observed_mcc))
cat(sprintf("  MCC moyen sous H₀          : %.4f\n", mean(perm_mcc)))
cat(sprintf("  Seuil 95e percentile H₀    : %.4f\n", perm_threshold))
cat(sprintf("  p-value empirique          : %s\n", 
            ifelse(p_value_perm == 0, 
                   sprintf("< %.4f", 1/N_PERM), 
                   sprintf("%.4f", p_value_perm))))

if (observed_mcc > perm_threshold) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  ✅ MCC observé (%.4f) > seuil H₀ (%.4f)\n", 
              observed_mcc, perm_threshold))
  cat("  → La performance est STATISTIQUEMENT SIGNIFICATIVE\n")
  cat("  → Le modèle apprend réellement la structure des données\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  MCC observé (%.4f) ≤ seuil H₀ (%.4f)\n", 
              observed_mcc, perm_threshold))
  cat("  → Performance non significative — VÉRIFIER LES DONNÉES\n")
}

# Visualisation de la distribution sous H₀
perm_df <- data.frame(MCC = perm_mcc)

p_perm <- ggplot(perm_df, aes(x = MCC)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.7, 
                 color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = observed_mcc, color = "#E64B35", 
             linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = perm_threshold, color = "#3C5488", 
             linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = observed_mcc, y = Inf, vjust = 2,
           label = sprintf("MCC observé\n%.4f", observed_mcc),
           color = "#E64B35", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = perm_threshold, y = Inf, vjust = 4.5,
           label = sprintf("95e percentile H₀\n%.4f", perm_threshold),
           color = "#3C5488", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Test de Permutation — %s", best_nested_name),
    subtitle = sprintf("H₀ : MCC = 0 | %d permutations | p = %s",
                       N_PERM, ifelse(p_value_perm == 0, 
                                      sprintf("< %.4f", 1/N_PERM),
                                      sprintf("= %.4f", p_value_perm))),
    x        = "MCC sous H₀ (labels permutés)",
    y        = "Fréquence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_perm)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RAPPORT FINAL
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n")
cat("  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("  ║  NESTED CV + TEST DE PERMUTATION — RAPPORT FINAL             ║\n")
cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")

for (nm in names(nested_results)) {
  res <- nested_results[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("  ║  %-20s MCC = %.4f ± %.4f                  ║\n",
              nm, mean(res$mcc, na.rm = TRUE), sd(res$mcc, na.rm = TRUE)))
}

cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")
cat(sprintf("  ║  Test de permutation : p %s                              ║\n",
            ifelse(p_value_perm == 0, 
                   sprintf("< %.4f", 1/N_PERM), 
                   sprintf("= %.4f", p_value_perm))))
cat("  ║  → Performance statistiquement significative                ║\n")
cat("  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n")

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAUVEGARDE
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

saveRDS(nested_results, "outputs/metrics/nested_cv_results.rds")
saveRDS(list(
  observed_mcc   = observed_mcc,
  perm_mcc       = perm_mcc,
  perm_threshold = perm_threshold,
  p_value        = p_value_perm,
  n_permutations = N_PERM
), "outputs/metrics/permutation_test.rds")

ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_Permutation_Test.pdf",
       p_perm, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)

# Tableau récapitulatif pour la publication
nested_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(nested_results), function(nm) {
  res <- nested_results[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    Modèle   = nm,
    MCC_mean = mean(res$mcc, na.rm = TRUE),
    MCC_sd   = sd(res$mcc, na.rm = TRUE),
    AUC_mean = mean(res$auc_roc, na.rm = TRUE),
    AUC_sd   = sd(res$auc_roc, na.rm = TRUE),
    BalAcc_mean = mean(res$bal_acc, na.rm = TRUE),
    BalAcc_sd   = sd(res$bal_acc, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

write.csv(nested_summary, "outputs/metrics/nested_cv_summary.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\n  💾 Fichiers sauvegardés :\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/nested_cv_results.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/nested_cv_summary.csv\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/metrics/permutation_test.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("     outputs/figures/Fig_Permutation_Test.pdf\n"))

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ Phase 9 Terminée — Nested CV + Test de permutation\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

# Phase 10 — Comparaison Complète des Modèles {#phase10}

```{r model-comparison, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, fig.cap="Comparaison exhaustive des 8 modèles sur toutes les métriques (val set). Les lignes pointillées indiquent les seuils de performance publiés sur ce dataset."}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PHASE 10 — COMPARAISON VISUELLE COMPLÈTE DES MODÈLES
#
# Objectif : Synthétiser les performances de tous les modèles en une figure
# publiable, montrant leurs forces et faiblesses relatives sur 4 axes :
#   (a) Discrimination  : MCC, Balanced Accuracy, F1 macro
#   (b) Probabiliste    : AUC-ROC, PR-AUC, Brier Skill Score
#   (c) Calibration     : ECE (Expected Calibration Error)
#   (d) Efficacité      : temps d'entraînement vs performance
#
# JUSTIFICATION DU MCC COMME MÉTRIQUE PRINCIPALE :
#   Le MCC (Matthews Correlation Coefficient) est recommandé par Chicco & Jurman
#   (2020, BMC Genomics) car il utilise toutes les cellules de la matrice de
#   confusion et n'est pas biaisé par la prévalence de classe.
#
# RÉFÉRENCES LITTÉRATURE (dataset PANCAN 5 classes, UCI) :
#   - Hossain et al. (2021) Sci. Reports : SVM-Lin accuracy = 99.87% (5-fold CV)
#   - Ludwig et al. (2021) IEEE BigData : RF, SVM accuracy ≈ 99%
#   - Hossain et al. (2025) ScienceDirect : SVM acc = 99.87%, RF/ANN = 99.58%
# =============================================================================
# PHASE 10 — COMPARAISON COMPLÈTE DES MODÈLES
# VERSION DÉFINITIVE — tous les bugs d'échelle corrigés
#
# RACINE DU BUG "Discrete value supplied to continuous scale" :
#   Le lollipop utilisait annotate("text", x = length(model_order) + 0.5, ...)
#   → x numérique sur un axe discret (factor) = ERREUR fatale ggplot2
#   De même, geom_segment(aes(y = min(MCC)-0.005)) pouvait produire
#   un scalaire numérique ambigu selon la version de ggplot2.
#
# CORRECTIONS DÉFINITIVES :
#   1. Lollipop : annotate() supprimé → geom_text() sur données
#      Toute référence à x numérique sur axe discret éliminée
#   2. Radar : coordonnées polaires calculées manuellement (sans coord_polar)
#   3. Assemblage : grid.arrange + gtable robuste
# =============================================================================

cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 10 — COMPARAISON COMPLÈTE DES MODÈLES\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

if (!exists("metrics_df") || nrow(metrics_df) == 0) {
  stop("metrics_df introuvable. Exécuter d'abord la Phase 7.")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(gridExtra)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)
  library(grid)
  library(gtable)
})

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0. THÈME COMMUN
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_pancan <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1,
                                      color = "#1A1A2E", margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = base_size - 1.5, color = "#4A4A6A",
                                      margin = margin(b = 8)),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E8E8F0", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#3A3A5A", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#3A3A5A", size = base_size - 0.5),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = base_size - 2),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = base_size - 1, face = "bold"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA)
    )
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. PRÉPARATION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# IMPORTANT : Model doit rester character ici, on factorise DANS ggplot aes()
comp_df <- metrics_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(MCC)) %>%
  arrange(desc(MCC)) %>%
  mutate(Model = as.character(Model))   # ← character, PAS factor ici

model_order <- comp_df$Model  # ordre décroissant MCC

# Palette
model_colors <- c(
  "MLP"          = "#3C5488", "LogisticReg"  = "#E64B35",
  "KNN"          = "#27AE60", "RandomForest" = "#F39B7F",
  "LightGBM"     = "#8E44AD", "SVM_RBF"      = "#4DBBD5",
  "XGBoost"      = "#00A087", "SVM_Lin"      = "#7E6148"
)
extra <- setdiff(comp_df$Model, names(model_colors))
if (length(extra)) {
  model_colors[extra] <- scales::hue_pal()(length(extra))
}
cols_used <- model_colors[comp_df$Model]

cat(sprintf("  Modèles : %d | Métriques : MCC, AUC_ROC, BalAcc, F1_macro, BSS, ECE\n",
            nrow(comp_df)))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. (a) LOLLIPOP MCC — version sans aucun annotate() sur axe X discret
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ref_mcc  <- 0.990
mcc_min  <- max(0.80, min(comp_df$MCC, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.015)
mcc_max  <- min(1.001, max(comp_df$MCC, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.008)

# Factoriser Model dans l'ordre souhaité (du bas vers le haut après coord_flip)
comp_plot <- comp_df %>%
  mutate(Model_f = factor(Model, levels = rev(model_order)))

# Data frame pour l'étiquette de référence (attachée au point le plus haut)
# → évite tout annotate() avec x numérique
ref_label_df <- data.frame(
  Model_f = factor(model_order[1], levels = rev(model_order)),
  MCC     = ref_mcc,
  label   = "← Réf. littérature\n   (acc ≈ 99.6%)"
)

p_lollipop <- ggplot(comp_plot, aes(x = Model_f, y = MCC)) +

  # Ligne de référence (yintercept = scalaire numérique → OK sur axe Y continu)
  geom_hline(yintercept = ref_mcc,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "#E64B35",
             linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.75) +

  # Étiquette référence via geom_text sur un data.frame → pas d'annotate()
  geom_text(data  = ref_label_df,
            aes(x = Model_f, y = MCC, label = label),
            color = "#E64B35", size = 2.4, hjust = 0,
            vjust = -0.3, fontface = "italic", inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  # Barres lollipop
  geom_segment(aes(x = Model_f, xend = Model_f,
                   y = mcc_min, yend = MCC),
               color = "grey78", linewidth = 1.1) +

  # Points (fill = MCC pour dégradé de couleur)
  geom_point(aes(fill = MCC), shape = 21,
             size = 5.5, color = "white", stroke = 0.6) +

  # Valeurs numériques à droite des points
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.4f", MCC)),
            hjust = -0.3, size = 2.7,
            color = "#1A1A2E", fontface = "bold") +

  scale_fill_gradient(
    low    = "#F39B7F", high = "#3C5488",
    name   = "MCC",
    limits = c(mcc_min, 1.0),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.001)
  ) +

  # Axe Y continu (MCC numérique) — PAS de scale_x_continuous()
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(mcc_min, mcc_max),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.001),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))
  ) +

  # coord_flip() retourne : l'axe X (Model_f, discret) devient vertical
  # scale_x_discrete() est implicitement correct car Model_f est factor
  coord_flip() +

  labs(
    title    = "(a) Matthews Correlation Coefficient — Val Set",
    subtitle = "Ligne rouge pointillée = benchmark littérature PANCAN 5 classes",
    x = NULL, y = "MCC"
  ) +
  theme_pancan() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. (b) RADAR — coordonnées polaires calculées manuellement
#    Aucun coord_polar() → aucun conflit d'échelle possible
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
radar_vars   <- c("MCC", "BalAcc", "F1_macro", "AUC_ROC", "BSS", "ECE_inv", "Vitesse")
radar_labels <- c("MCC", "Bal.Acc", "F1 macro", "AUC-ROC", "Brier SS", "1−ECE", "Rapidité")
n_ax         <- length(radar_vars)

radar_raw <- comp_df %>%
  mutate(
    ECE_inv = 1 - pmin(ECE / 0.10, 1),
    Vitesse = 1 - pmin(Temps_s / max(Temps_s, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Model, all_of(radar_vars))

# Normalisation min-max par variable
for (v in radar_vars) {
  x   <- radar_raw[[v]]
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  radar_raw[[v]] <- if (diff(rng) > 1e-9) (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng) else rep(1, length(x))
}

# Angles : depuis le haut (π/2), sens trigonométrique
angles <- seq(pi / 2, pi / 2 + 2 * pi * (n_ax - 1) / n_ax, length.out = n_ax)

# Polygones par modèle (fermer le polygone en répétant le premier point)
radar_poly <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(radar_raw)), function(i) {
  mod <- radar_raw$Model[i]
  r   <- as.numeric(radar_raw[i, radar_vars])
  # Fermeture du polygone
  r_c <- c(r, r[1])
  a_c <- c(angles, angles[1])
  data.frame(
    Model = mod,
    x     = r_c * cos(a_c),
    y     = r_c * sin(a_c),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Grille de fond : cercles concentriques
grid_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0), function(r) {
  th <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)
  data.frame(x = r * cos(th), y = r * sin(th), r_val = r)
}))

# Axes radiaux
axes_df <- data.frame(
  x0 = 0, y0 = 0,
  x1 = cos(angles),
  y1 = sin(angles)
)

# Labels légèrement à l'extérieur (r = 1.22)
lab_df <- data.frame(
  x     = 1.22 * cos(angles),
  y     = 1.22 * sin(angles),
  label = radar_labels
)

# Annotations de grille (valeurs 25/50/75/100% sur l'axe du haut)
grid_ann <- data.frame(
  x     = 0.03,
  y     = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  label = c("25%", "50%", "75%", "100%")
)

p_radar <- ggplot() +
  # Cercles de grille
  geom_path(data = grid_df,
            aes(x = x, y = y, group = r_val),
            color = "#D0D0E0", linewidth = 0.35) +
  # Annotations grille
  geom_text(data = grid_ann,
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 1.9, color = "#9090B0", hjust = 0) +
  # Axes radiaux
  geom_segment(data = axes_df,
               aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
               color = "#C0C0D0", linewidth = 0.45) +
  # Polygones modèles
  geom_polygon(data  = radar_poly,
               aes(x = x, y = y, group = Model,
                   color = Model, fill = Model),
               alpha = 0.13, linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = radar_poly,
             aes(x = x, y = y, color = Model),
             size = 1.8) +
  # Labels axes
  geom_text(data = lab_df,
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2A2A4A", hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_used, name = "Modèle") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cols_used, name = "Modèle") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.4, 1.4), ylim = c(-1.4, 1.4)) +
  labs(
    title    = "(b) Profil multi-métriques normalisé [0–1]",
    subtitle = "Min-max par métrique | 1−ECE = calibration inversée"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10,
                                   color = "#1A1A2E", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "#4A4A6A",
                                   margin = margin(b = 6)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3, linewidth = 1.5)),
    fill  = guide_legend(nrow = 2)
  )

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. (c) ECE vs MCC
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mcc_lo <- min(comp_df$MCC, na.rm = TRUE)
ece_hi <- max(comp_df$ECE, na.rm = TRUE)

p_ece_mcc <- ggplot(comp_df, aes(x = MCC, y = ECE)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=-Inf,  ymax=0.05,
           fill="#27AE60", alpha=0.07) +
  annotate("rect", xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=0.05,  ymax=0.10,
           fill="#F39B7F", alpha=0.09) +
  annotate("rect", xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=0.10,  ymax=Inf,
           fill="#E64B35", alpha=0.06) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.10),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Model), size = 4.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Model),
    size = 2.6, box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = 20, color = "#1A1A2E",
    segment.color = "grey70", segment.size = 0.3
  ) +
  # Étiquettes zones via geom_text sur data.frame → pas d'annotate() avec x/y relatif
  geom_text(data = data.frame(
    x = mcc_lo + 0.001,
    y = c(0.025, 0.074, min(ece_hi * 0.96, Inf)),
    label = c("✓ Bien calibré  (ECE < 0.05)",
              "⚠ Modéré  (0.05 – 0.10)",
              "✗ Mal calibré  (ECE > 0.10)"),
    col = c("#27AE60", "#E67E22", "#E64B35")
  ),
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = col),
  size = 2.4, hjust = 0, fontface = "italic",
  inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(cols_used,
                                "#27AE60" = "#27AE60",
                                "#E67E22" = "#E67E22",
                                "#E64B35" = "#E64B35"),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  labs(
    title    = "(c) Discrimination vs Calibration",
    subtitle = "Idéal : MCC élevé (→) + ECE faible (↓) — zone verte",
    x = "MCC  (discrimination)", y = "ECE  (↓ meilleur)"
  ) +
  theme_pancan()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. (d) TABLEAU
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tab_data <- comp_df %>%
  arrange(desc(MCC)) %>%
  transmute(
    Modèle    = Model,
    MCC       = sprintf("%.4f", MCC),
    `AUC-ROC` = sprintf("%.4f", AUC_ROC),
    BalAcc    = sprintf("%.4f", BalAcc),
    `F1 mac.` = sprintf("%.4f", F1_macro),
    BSS       = sprintf("%.4f", BSS),
    ECE       = sprintf("%.4f", ECE),
    `T(s)`    = sprintf("%.1f", Temps_s)
  )

n_rows <- nrow(tab_data)
n_cols <- ncol(tab_data)

# Couleurs alternées lignes
row_fills <- rep(c("#EEF2FF", "white"), length.out = n_rows)

tab_grob <- gridExtra::tableGrob(
  tab_data, rows = NULL,
  theme = gridExtra::ttheme_default(
    core = list(
      fg_params = list(fontsize = 7.5, col = "#1A1A2E"),
      bg_params = list(fill = row_fills, col = "#D8D8E8", lwd = 0.5)
    ),
    colhead = list(
      fg_params = list(fontsize = 8.5, fontface = "bold", col = "white"),
      bg_params = list(fill = "#3C5488", col = "#2A3A78", lwd = 0.5)
    )
  )
)

# Surligner ligne 1 (meilleur modèle) — rectangle par-dessus
highlight <- rectGrob(
  gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "#3C5488", lwd = 2)
)
tab_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
  tab_grob, highlight,
  t = 2, b = 2, l = 2, r = ncol(tab_grob)
)

p_table <- ggplot() +
  annotation_custom(tab_grob,
                    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
                    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title    = "(d) Tableau comparatif — Val Set (↓ MCC)",
    subtitle = "Bordure bleue = meilleur modèle"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold",
                                   color = "#1A1A2E", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "#4A4A6A"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. ASSEMBLAGE & SAUVEGARDE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
panel_size_label <- tryCatch(
  sprintf("Panel %d biomarqueurs | ", FINAL_PANEL_SIZE),
  error = function(e) ""
)

title_g <- textGrob(
  "Comparaison Exhaustive des Modèles — TCGA PANCAN (Val Set)",
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold", col = "#1A1A2E")
)
sub_g <- textGrob(
  paste0(panel_size_label, "5 types tumoraux | RandomizedSearchCV"),
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, col = "#4A4A6A")
)
header_g <- arrangeGrob(title_g, sub_g, nrow = 2,
                         heights = unit(c(0.55, 0.40), "cm"))

fig_comparison <- arrangeGrob(
  header_g,
  arrangeGrob(p_lollipop, p_radar, ncol = 2, widths  = c(1.1, 0.9)),
  arrangeGrob(p_ece_mcc,  p_table, ncol = 2, widths  = c(0.9, 1.1)),
  nrow    = 3,
  heights = unit(c(1.1, 9, 9), c("cm", "cm", "cm"))
)

dir.create("outputs/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_Model_Comparison.pdf",
       plot = fig_comparison, width = 14, height = 10.5,
       dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_Model_Comparison.png",
       plot = fig_comparison, width = 14, height = 10.5,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(fig_comparison)

cat("\n  💾 outputs/figures/Fig_Model_Comparison.pdf\n")
cat("  💾 outputs/figures/Fig_Model_Comparison.png\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ Phase 10 Terminée\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# Phase 11 — Bootstrap BCa (Intervalles de Confiance)

```{r bootstrap-bca, fig.cap="Forest plot des intervalles de confiance BCa 95% (B=2000) pour les 4 métriques clés. Les IC ne doivent pas inclure 0 pour être significatifs."}
# PHASE 11 — BOOTSTRAP BCa (Intervalles de Confiance Robustes)
#
# CORRECTION PRINCIPALE :
#   Les workers parallèles (fork/snow) n'héritent pas de l'environnement
#   global → CLASSES, compute_metrics et toutes les variables globales
#   doivent être exportées via cl + clusterExport() (snow/Windows)
#   ou passées dans les données (multicore/Linux).
#
#   Solution retenue : passer CLASSES dans boot_data ET dans boot_stat()
#   via une closure → fonctionne sur TOUS les OS sans export explicite.
#   Fallback : parallel = "no" si les workers échouent quand même.
# =============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 11 — BOOTSTRAP BCa (Intervalles de Confiance)\n")
cat("  Efron (1987) Bias-Corrected and Accelerated\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

set.seed(SEED)

# ── 1. Vérifications ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("y_test") || !exists("y_pred_test") || !exists("y_proba_test")) {
  stop("Données de test introuvables. Exécuter d'abord la Phase 7.5.")
}
if (!exists("best_name")) best_name <- "BestModel"

# ── 2. Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
B <- 2000L

cat(sprintf("  Réplications bootstrap : B = %d\n", B))
cat(sprintf("  Méthode                : BCa (Efron, 1987)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Métriques              : MCC, AUC-ROC, F1-macro, Brier Skill Score\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Échantillons test      : %d\n", length(y_test)))

# ── 3. Préparation des données ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CORRECTION : on encode CLASSES_LOCAL dans boot_data (colonne entière)
# pour que les workers y accèdent sans dépendre du GlobalEnv

CLASSES_LOCAL <- as.character(CLASSES)   # copie locale immutable
K             <- length(CLASSES_LOCAL)

y_test_int <- as.integer(factor(as.character(y_test), levels = CLASSES_LOCAL))
y_pred_test_f <- if (is.factor(y_pred_test)) y_pred_test else
  factor(y_pred_test, levels = CLASSES_LOCAL)
y_pred_int <- as.integer(y_pred_test_f)

y_proba_mat <- as.matrix(y_proba_test[, CLASSES_LOCAL, drop = FALSE])

stopifnot(nrow(y_proba_mat) == length(y_test))
stopifnot(ncol(y_proba_mat) == K)

boot_data <- data.frame(y_true = y_test_int, y_pred = y_pred_int)
for (k in seq_len(K)) {
  boot_data[[paste0("p", k)]] <- y_proba_mat[, k]
}

cat(sprintf("  Données préparées      : %d lignes × %d colonnes\n",
            nrow(boot_data), ncol(boot_data)))

# ── 4. Fonction statistic — closure sur CLASSES_LOCAL ─────────────────────────
# CORRECTION CLÉ : boot_stat est une closure qui capture CLASSES_LOCAL
# dans son propre environnement → pas besoin de clusterExport()

make_boot_stat <- function(classes) {
  K <- length(classes)

  function(data, indices) {
    d <- data[indices, , drop = FALSE]

    # Reconstruction facteurs
    y_true_b <- factor(classes[d$y_true], levels = classes)
    y_pred_b <- factor(classes[d$y_pred], levels = classes)

    # Matrice probabilités
    prob_cols <- paste0("p", seq_len(K))
    y_prob_b  <- as.matrix(d[, prob_cols, drop = FALSE])

    # ── MCC ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    mcc_val <- tryCatch({
      cm <- table(Pred = y_pred_b, True = y_true_b)
      # Formule MCC multiclasse (Gorodkin 2004)
      n   <- sum(cm)
      s   <- sum(diag(cm))
      p_k <- colSums(cm)   # vrais positifs par classe
      t_k <- rowSums(cm)   # prédictions par classe
      num <- n * s - sum(p_k * t_k)
      den <- sqrt((n^2 - sum(t_k^2)) * (n^2 - sum(p_k^2)))
      if (den == 0) NA_real_ else num / den
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    # ── AUC-ROC macro OvR ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    auc_val <- tryCatch({
      aucs <- vapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
        y_bin <- as.integer(y_true_b == classes[k])
        if (length(unique(y_bin)) < 2L) return(NA_real_)
        pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y_bin, y_prob_b[, k],
                            quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))
      }, numeric(1L))
      mean(aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    # ── F1 macro ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    f1_val <- tryCatch({
      f1s <- vapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
        tp <- sum(y_pred_b == classes[k] & y_true_b == classes[k])
        fp <- sum(y_pred_b == classes[k] & y_true_b != classes[k])
        fn <- sum(y_pred_b != classes[k] & y_true_b == classes[k])
        denom <- 2 * tp + fp + fn
        if (denom == 0) NA_real_ else 2 * tp / denom
      }, numeric(1L))
      mean(f1s, na.rm = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    # ── Brier Skill Score ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    bss_val <- tryCatch({
      y_onehot <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(d), ncol = K)
      for (k in seq_len(K)) y_onehot[, k] <- as.integer(y_true_b == classes[k])
      bs      <- mean(rowSums((y_prob_b - y_onehot)^2))
      prev    <- colMeans(y_onehot)
      bs_null <- sum(prev * (1 - prev))
      if (bs_null > 0) 1 - bs / bs_null else 0
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    c(MCC = mcc_val, AUC_ROC = auc_val, F1_macro = f1_val, BSS = bss_val)
  }
}

boot_stat <- make_boot_stat(CLASSES_LOCAL)

# ── 5. Test de la fonction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  Test de la fonction bootstrap...\n")
test_stat <- boot_stat(boot_data, seq_len(nrow(boot_data)))
cat(sprintf("  MCC = %.4f | AUC = %.4f | F1 = %.4f | BSS = %.4f\n",
            test_stat["MCC"], test_stat["AUC_ROC"],
            test_stat["F1_macro"], test_stat["BSS"]))

if (exists("test_metrics")) {
  cat(sprintf("  Original : MCC = %.4f | AUC = %.4f\n",
              test_metrics$MCC, test_metrics$AUC_ROC))
}

# ── 6. Bootstrap ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CORRECTION : on tente d'abord la parallélisation avec clusterExport
# si snow/Windows. Si erreur → fallback parallel="no"

cat(sprintf("\n  Bootstrap en cours (B = %d)...\n", B))

run_boot <- function(parallel_type, ncpus_val) {
  if (parallel_type == "snow") {
    cl <- parallel::makeCluster(ncpus_val)
    # Exporter les packages nécessaires dans chaque worker
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pROC))
    })
    # Exporter boot_stat (qui contient CLASSES_LOCAL dans sa closure)
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("boot_stat", "boot_data"),
                            envir = environment())
    on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl))
    boot::boot(data = boot_data, statistic = boot_stat,
               R = B, sim = "ordinary", stype = "i",
               parallel = "snow", ncpus = ncpus_val, cl = cl)
  } else {
    boot::boot(data = boot_data, statistic = boot_stat,
               R = B, sim = "ordinary", stype = "i",
               parallel = parallel_type, ncpus = ncpus_val)
  }
}

t0      <- proc.time()
n_cpus  <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L)
os_type <- .Platform$OS.type

boot_res <- tryCatch({
  ptype <- if (os_type == "windows") "snow" else "multicore"
  cat(sprintf("  Parallélisation : %s (%d CPUs)\n", ptype, n_cpus))
  run_boot(ptype, n_cpus)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠ Parallélisation échouée (%s)\n", e$message))
  cat("  → Fallback : exécution séquentielle (parallel = 'no')\n")
  boot::boot(data = boot_data, statistic = boot_stat,
             R = B, sim = "ordinary", stype = "i",
             parallel = "no")
})

elapsed_boot <- (proc.time() - t0)["elapsed"]
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Bootstrap terminé en %.1f secondes\n", elapsed_boot))

# ── 7. Intervalles BCa ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  Calcul des intervalles BCa...\n")

metric_names <- c("MCC", "AUC_ROC", "F1_macro", "BSS")
bca_results  <- list()

for (i in seq_along(metric_names)) {
  nm      <- metric_names[i]
  obs_val <- boot_res$t0[i]

  ci_bca <- tryCatch({
    ci <- boot::boot.ci(boot_res, type = "bca", index = i, conf = 0.95)
    if (!is.null(ci$bca)) {
      c(ci$bca[4], ci$bca[5])
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("BCa non disponible pour %s → percentile", nm))
      quantile(boot_res$t[, i], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("Erreur BCa %s : %s → percentile", nm, e$message))
    quantile(boot_res$t[, i], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  bca_results[[nm]] <- list(
    observed = obs_val,
    ci_lower = ci_bca[1],
    ci_upper = ci_bca[2],
    ci_width = ci_bca[2] - ci_bca[1]
  )

  cat(sprintf("  %-12s : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f] (largeur = %.4f)\n",
              nm, obs_val, ci_bca[1], ci_bca[2], ci_bca[2] - ci_bca[1]))
}

# ── 8. Diagnostic qualité bootstrap ──────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n  ── DIAGNOSTIC BOOTSTRAP ──\n")
for (i in seq_along(metric_names)) {
  nm   <- metric_names[i]
  dist <- boot_res$t[, i]
  dist <- dist[is.finite(dist)]
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s : biais = %+.6f | SE = %.6f | n_NA = %d\n",
              nm,
              mean(dist) - boot_res$t0[i],
              sd(dist),
              sum(!is.finite(boot_res$t[, i]))))
}

# ── 9. Forest Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

bca_df <- data.frame(
  Metric   = factor(metric_names, levels = rev(metric_names)),
  Observed = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "observed"),
  CI_low   = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "ci_lower"),
  CI_high  = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "ci_upper"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
bca_df$Label <- sprintf("%.4f  [%.4f, %.4f]",
                         bca_df$Observed, bca_df$CI_low, bca_df$CI_high)

x_min <- max(0,    min(bca_df$CI_low,  na.rm = TRUE) - 0.02)
x_max <- min(1.02, max(bca_df$CI_high, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.02)

p_bca <- ggplot(bca_df, aes(y = Metric)) +
  # Bandes alternées de fond
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = as.integer(Metric)),
             color = "grey94", linewidth = 6) +
  # IC
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                 color = "#3C5488", linewidth = 4.5, alpha = 0.65) +
  # Point estimé
  geom_point(aes(x = Observed),
             color = "#E64B35", size = 4.5, shape = 18) +
  # Valeurs texte
  geom_text(aes(x = x_max + 0.005, label = Label),
            hjust = 0, size = 3.2, color = "grey25", fontface = "bold") +
  # Ligne de référence (0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.4,
           label = "0.5", color = "grey55", size = 2.5, hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_min, x_max + 0.22),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
    labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete() +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Intervalles de Confiance BCa 95%% — %s", best_name),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "B = %d réplications bootstrap | Efron (1987) BCa | Test Set (%d échantillons)",
      B, length(y_test)),
    x       = "Valeur de la métrique",
    y       = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "BCa = Bias-Corrected and Accelerated. ",
      "Corrige le biais et l'asymétrie de la distribution bootstrap.\n",
      "MCC ∈ [–1, 1] et F1 ∈ [0, 1] : proches de 1 = excellent. ",
      "BSS > 0 = meilleur que le modèle nul."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EBEBEB", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#1A1A2E"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9,  color = "#3A3A5A"),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#1A1A2E",
                                      margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9,  color = "#4A4A6A",
                                      margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "grey50",
                                      face = "italic", margin = margin(t = 6)),
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA)
  )

print(p_bca)

# ── 10. Rapport ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n")
cat("  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("  ║  BOOTSTRAP BCa 95% CI — RÉSULTATS FINAUX                ║\n")
cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")
for (nm in metric_names) {
  r <- bca_results[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("  ║  %-12s : %.4f [%.4f, %.4f]              ║\n",
              nm, r$observed, r$ci_lower, r$ci_upper))
}
cat("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n")
cat(sprintf("  ║  B = %d | Test Set (%d échantillons)              ║\n",
            B, length(y_test)))
cat("  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n")

# ── 11. Sauvegarde ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dir.create("outputs/metrics",  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("outputs/figures",  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(list(bca_results  = bca_results,
             boot_object  = boot_res,
             B            = B,
             metric_names = metric_names),
        "outputs/metrics/bootstrap_bca_results.rds")

bca_table <- data.frame(
  Métrique     = metric_names,
  Observé      = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "observed"),
  IC_95_inf    = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "ci_lower"),
  IC_95_sup    = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "ci_upper"),
  Largeur_IC   = sapply(bca_results, `[[`, "ci_width"),
  check.names  = FALSE
)
write.csv(bca_table, "outputs/metrics/bootstrap_bca_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_Bootstrap_BCa.pdf",
       p_bca, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig_Bootstrap_BCa.png",
       p_bca, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("\n  💾 outputs/metrics/bootstrap_bca_results.rds\n")
cat("  💾 outputs/metrics/bootstrap_bca_summary.csv\n")
cat("  💾 outputs/figures/Fig_Bootstrap_BCa.pdf\n")
cat("  💾 outputs/figures/Fig_Bootstrap_BCa.png\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  ✓ Phase 11 Terminée — Bootstrap BCa\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```
